verses.text: Uhoraho ahamagara Mose ari mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, aramubwira ati:
“Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Umuntu wese muri mwebwe azogomba gushikanira Uhoraho ishikanwa, azomushikanire igitungwa akuye mu bitungwa bininibinini canke bitobito.
Ico kimazi nicaba ari ico guturirwa kivuye mu bitungwa bininibinini, gitegerezwa kuba ari ishuri itagira agasembwa. Aze akijane imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro kugira ngo Uhoraho amwemere.
Aze arambike ikiganza ciwe ku mutwe w’ico kimazi co guturirwa, hanyuma Uhoraho azokwemera ko gipfuye mu gishingo ciwe ngo kibe impongano y’ivyaha vyiwe.
Azoce akererera iyo shuri imbere y’ Uhoraho , maze abaherezi bene Aroni baze bazane amaraso yayo bayamije ku mpande zose z’igicaniro imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Hanyuma azoce akura urusato kuri ico kimazi, agicemwo ibihimba.
Abahungu ba Aroni umuherezi bazoce bacana umuriro ku gicaniro bashireko inkwi.
Hanyuma abo baherezi bene Aroni baze bashire vya bihimba vyose kuri za nkwi ziri ku gicaniro, harimwo umutwe n’ibinure vyaco.
Aze yogeshe amazi ivyo mu nda n’amaguru, hanyuma umuherezi abituririre vyose ku gicaniro, nk’ikimazi co guturirwa, gitanzwe biciye mu guturirwa, ishikanwa rimota neza rinezera Uhoraho .
Ico kimazi nicaba ari ico guturirwa kivuye mu mukuku, ari impene canke intama, aze atange isuguru itagira agasembwa.
Aze ayikererere ku ruhande ruherereye mu buraruko bw’igicaniro imbere y’ Uhoraho , hanyuma abaherezi bene Aroni baze bamijagire amaraso y’iyo suguru ku mpande zose z’igicaniro.
Aze ayihimbaguremwo ibihimba, hanyuma umuherezi abitondeke ku nkwi ziriko zirakira ku gicaniro, harimwo umutwe n’ibinure vyayo.
Aze yogeshe amazi ivyo mu nda n’amaguru, hanyuma umuherezi abituririre vyose ku gicaniro, nk’ikimazi co guturirwa, gitanzwe biciye mu guturirwa, ishikanwa rimota neza rinezereza Uhoraho .
Ico kimazi co gushikanira Uhoraho nicaba ari ico guturirwa kivuye mu biguruka, aze atange inuma canke intunguru ikiri nto.
Umuherezi aze ayizane ku gicaniro, ayihotore izosi, ayice umutwe, awuturirire ku gicaniro, hanyuma areke amaraso yayo atembere ku ruhande rumwe rw’igicaniro.
Aze akureko agatorero n’ibirimwo vyose agaterere ku ruhande rwo mu buseruko bw’igicaniro, ahari umunyota.

Aze asaturemwo kubiri iyo nyoni, ayisaturire hagati y’amababa mu gukwega umubiri wayo, ariko ntaze atandukanye ivyo bice bibiri, hanyuma umuherezi aze ayituririre ku nkwi ziriko zirakira ku gicaniro, nk’ikimazi co guturirwa, gitanzwe biciye mu guturirwa, ishikanwa rimota neza rinezereza Uhoraho .
Nihagira uwushikanira Uhoraho ishikanwa ry’ivyimburwa bivamwo ifu, ishikanwa ryiwe rize ribe iry’ifu inoze neza. Aze ayisukeko amavuta, ashireko n’ibimota neza,

hanyuma ayishire abaherezi bene Aroni. Umuherezi aze ayore ifu yuzuye urushi kuri ya fu inoze neza ivanze n’amavuta hamwe na vya bimota neza, abituririre ku gicaniro kugira ngo ako gace kabe icibutso, ishikanwa rituriwe rimota neza rinezereza Uhoraho .
Ibisigaye kuri iryo shikanwa ry’ibivamwo ifu, ni ivya Aroni n’abahungu biwe; ni igice cejejwe kurusha ibindi mu mashikanwa ashikanirwa Uhoraho yo guturirwa n’umuriro.

Nimwatanga ishikanwa ry’ivyokejwe, rize ribe umukate ucumbwe mw’ifu inoze neza: udukate tutarimwo umwambiro kandi tuvanze n’amavuta ya elayo, canke udukate tutarimwo umwambiro tw’intimba nto tumijagiwe amavuta ya elayo.
Nimba ishikanwa ryawe ari udukate twokejwe kw’ipano, tuze tube dukozwe mw’ifu inoze neza ivanzwe n’amavuta kandi itarimwo umwambiro.
Uzotumanyuremwo utumanyu dutoduto hanyuma udusukeko amavuta; iryo rizoba ari ishikanwa ry’ifu.
Nimba ishikanwa ryawe ritetswe kw’ipano, rize ribe rigizwe n’ifu inoze neza ivanze n’amavuta ya Elayo.
Ishikanwa iryo ari ryo ryose rivuye mu biterwa bivamwo ifu ushikaniye Uhoraho , uzorihe umuherezi, na we azorijana ku gicaniro.
Aze akureko igice c’icibutso agituririre ku gicaniro nk’ishikanwa ryo guturirwa, ritanzwe biciye mu guturirwa, ishikanwa rimota neza rinezera Uhoraho .
Ibisigaye kuri iryo shikanwa ry’ibivamwo ifu, ni ivya Aroni n’abahungu biwe; ni igice cejejwe kurusha ibindi mu mashikanwa ashikanirwa Uhoraho yo guturirwa n’umuriro.
Ishikanwa ryose rivuye mu vyimburwa bivamwo ifu muzoshikanira Uhoraho rize ribe ritarimwo umwambiro, kuko mudakwiye guturira umwambiro canke ubuki mw’ishikanwa mushikaniye Uhoraho .
Ivyo muzoshobora kubishikanira Uhoraho nk’amashikanwa y’ivyeze imbere y’ibindi, atari amashikanwa atuririwe ku gicaniro nk’ikimazi kimota neza.

Muze murunge umunyu mu mashikanwa yanyu yose avuye mu vyimburwa. Ntimuze mwibagire gushiramwo umunyu kuko umunyu werekana isezerano riri hagati y’Imana yanyu namwe. Muze mushiremwo umunyu mu mashikanwa yanyu yose avuye mu vyimburwa bivamwo ifu.
Nimwashikanira Uhoraho amashikanwa avuye mu vyimburwa bivamwo ifu vyimbuwe ubwa mbere, muze mufate imikama y’ingano mukuye mu mirima, muzotse ku muriro, hanyuma intete zazo muzisye.
Muze mwongereko amavuta n’ibimota neza; rizoba ribaye ishikanwa rivuye mu vyimburwa bivamwo ifu.
Umuherezi aze akureko igice c’icibutso, agituririre hamwe na ya mavuta na vya bimota neza, iryo ni ishikanwa rishikaniwe Uhoraho ku gicaniro.
Niwatanga ikimazi c’ishimwe kivuye mu bitungwa bininibinini, uze ushikane imbere y’ Uhoraho ishuri canke inka ivyara, ariko itagira agasembwa.
Uwutanze ico kimazi aze arambike ikiganza ciwe ku mutwe waco hanyuma agikererere ku muryango w’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro. Maze abaherezi bene Aroni baze bamijagire amaraso yaco ku mpande zose z’igicaniro.
Aze akure kuri ico kimazi c’ishimwe ivyo gushikanira Uhoraho nk’ishikanwa ryo guturirwa n’umuriro rigizwe n’ibi bikurikira: ibinure vyose bifatanye n’ivyo mu nda,
amafyigo yompi n’ibinure biri kuri yo n’ibiri ku mbavu hamwe n’igice cose gipfutse igitigu, ico azokuranako n’amafyigo.
Ivyo vyose bene Aroni baze babituririre ku gicaniro, hejuru y’ikimazi co guturirwa kigeretse ku nkwi; iryo ni ishikanwa rituriwe n’umuriro, rimota neza, rinezereza Uhoraho .
Naho niyatanga ikimazi c’ishimwe kivuye mu bitungwa bitobito nk’ikimazi ashikaniye Uhoraho , kizobe ari isuguru canke iyivyara, ariko itagira agasembwa.
Niyatanga intama, aze ayijane imbere y’ Uhoraho ,
ashire ikiganza ku mutwe wayo imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro, hanyuma ayikererereho. Maze abaherezi bene Aroni baze bamijagire amaraso yayo ku mpande zose z’igicaniro.

Kuri ico kimazi c’ishimwe aze ashikanire Uhoraho ishikanwa ryo guturira ku gicaniro rigizwe n’ibi bikurikira: ibinure vyaco, umurizo wose uko bazoba bawukuye ku ruti rw’umugongo, ibinure vyose bifatanye n’ivyo mu nda,
amafyigo yompi n’ibinure biri kuri yo n’ivyo mu mbavu, n’igice gipfutse igitigu, ico azokurirako rimwe n’amafyigo.
Umuherezi aze abituririre ku gicaniro nk’imfungurwa zituriwe n’umuriro zishikaniwe Uhoraho .
Ico kimazi nicaba ari impene, aze akizane imbere y’ Uhoraho ,
arambike ikiganza ciwe ku mutwe waco hanyuma agikererere imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro. Aze aheze amijagire amaraso yaco ku mpande zose z’igicaniro.
Ku kimazi yatanze aze akureko ishikanwa ry’ Uhoraho ryo guturirwa n’umuriro ry’ibihimba bikurikira: ibinure vyose bipfutse ivyo mu nda canke ibifatanye na vyo,
amafyigo yompi n’ibinure biri kuri yo n’ivyo mu mbavu, n’igice gipfutse igitigu, ico azokurirako rimwe n’amafyigo.
Umuherezi aze abituririre ku gicaniro nk’imfungurwa zishikaniwe Uhoraho , bibe ishikanwa rimota neza. Ibinure vyose ni ivy’ Uhoraho .
Iri ni ibwirizwa ry’intahava uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi, aho muzoba muri hose: ntimuze murye ibinure canke amaraso.’ ”
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Bwira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Umuntu niyacumura atabiteguye, agakora ibinyuranye n’ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho , uku ni ko bizohora bigenda:
Abaye ari umuherezi yarobanujwe amavuta yacumuye, akazanira abantu gutsindwa n’urubanza, aze ashikanire Uhoraho ishuri itagira agasembwa kw’ikimazi atangiye icaha yakoze.
Aze azane iyo shuri mu rwinjiriro rw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro imbere y’ Uhoraho , arambike ikiganza ciwe ku mutwe wayo hanyuma ayikererere imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Hanyuma uwo muherezi yarobanujwe amavuta aze afate igice c’amaraso y’iyo shuri ayatware mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Aze akoze urutoke rwiwe muri ayo maraso aheze ayamijagire incuro indwi imbere y’ Uhoraho , imbere y’igihuzu gikingiriye ahera ho mw’ihema.

Umuherezi aze yongere afate ikindi gice c’amaraso ayasige ku mahembe y’igicaniro baturirirako ibimota neza kiri imbere y’ Uhoraho mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro. Amaraso asigaye y’iyo shuri aze ayasuke i ruhande y’igicaniro co guturirirako ibimazi kiri mu rwinjiriro rw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Aze akureko ibinure vyose kuri iyo shuri itangiwe ivyaha: ibinure vyose bifatanye n’ivyo mu nda,
amafyigo yompi n’ibinure biri kuri yo n’ibifatanye n’imbavu, igice kiri hejuru y’igitigu, ico azokuranamwo n’amafyigo,
nka kurya ibinure bikurwa ku mpfizi itangwa kw’ikimazi c’ishimwe. Umuherezi aze abituririre ku gicaniro co guturirirako ibimazi.
Ariko urusato rw’iyo shuri, inyama zayo, umutwe, amaguru, ivyo mu nda vyose n’insogi,
ni ukuvuga ibisigaye vyose vyo kuri yo; aze abifate abijane inyuma y’aho mucumbitse mu kibanza gihumanuwe, ahatabwa umunyota, abiturire n’umuriro ku nkwi zigeretse ku kirundo c’umunyota.
Igihe Abisirayeli bose ari bo bazoba bacumuye ariko batabishaka, bagakora ibinyuranye n’ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho , naho abantu bose batomenya ko bacumuye, bazoba ari abo gutsindwa n’urubanza.
Nibamara gutahura icaha bakoze, Abisirayeli bose baze bazane ishuri kw’ikimazi c’ivyaha bayishikane imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Abakuru bo mu Bisirayeli baze barambike ibiganza vyabo ku mutwe w’iyo shuri imbere y’ Uhoraho , hanyuma iyo shuri ikerererwe imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Umuherezi yarobanujwe amavuta aze afate igice c’amaraso y’iyo shuri ayajane mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Aze akoze urutoke rwiwe muri ayo maraso aheze ayamijagire incuro indwi imbere y’ Uhoraho , imbere y’igihuzu gikingiriye ahera ho mw’ihema.

Aze asige igice c’ayo maraso ku mahembe y’igicaniro kiri imbere y’ Uhoraho mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro. Amaraso asigaye aze ayasese hasi i ruhande y’igicaniro co guturirirako ibimazi kiri mu rwinjiriro rw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Aze akureko ibinure vyose kuri ico kimazi aheze abituririre ku gicaniro,
hanyuma ibisigaye abikore nk’uko bikorwa kw’ishuri y’ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha. Uko ni ko umuherezi azotangira impongano ikoraniro ry’Abisirayeli, kandi bazoharirwa ivyaha vyabo.

Hanyuma aze afate ibice bisigaye vy’iyo shuri abikure aho bakoraniye, abiturire nk’uko bikorwa kw’ishuri itangirwa umuherezi yarobanujwe amavuta. Ico ni ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha vy’ikoraniro ry’Abisirayeli ryose.
Uwurongoye abandi mu Bisirayeli niyacumura atabishaka, agakora ibinyuranye n’ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe, ariko we ntamenye ko yacumuye, na ho nyene azoba ari uwo gutsindwa n’urubanza.
Niyamara gutahura icaha yakoze, aze azane ikimazi c’isuguru y’impene itagira agasembwa,
hanyuma arambike ikiganza ciwe ku mutwe wayo, ace ayikererera aho bakererera ibimazi bituririrwa imbere y’ Uhoraho . Ico ni ikimazi c’ivyaha.
Hanyuma umuherezi aze afate igice c’amaraso y’ico kimazi c’ivyaha ayasigishe urutoke ku mahembe y’igicaniro co guturirirako ibimazi hanyuma asese ayasigaye hasi i ruhande y’igicaniro.
Aze aturirire ibinure vyayo vyose ku gicaniro nk’uko baturira ibinure vy’ikimazi c’ishimwe. Uko ni ko umuherezi azotanga impongano y’icaha c’uwo mukuru mu Bisirayeli, kandi na we azoharirwa.
Abaye ari umuntu asanzwe muri mwebwe acumuye atabishaka, agakora ibinyuranye n’ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho , naho atoba abizi ko yacumuye, na ho nyene azoba ari uwo gutsindwa n’urubanza.
Niyamara gutahura icaha yakoze, aze atange impene y’ishashi itagira agasembwa nk’ikimazi c’icaha ciwe.
Aze arambike ikiganza ku mutwe w’ico kimazi c’ivyaha hanyuma agikererere mu kibanza c’ibimazi biturirwa n’umuriro.
Hanyuma umuherezi aze afate igice c’amaraso y’ico kimazi ayasigishe urutoke ku mahembe y’igicaniro co guturirirako ibimazi hanyuma asese ayasigaye hasi i ruhande y’igicaniro.

Aze akureko ibinure vyose, nk’uko bigenda ku kimazi c’ishimwe, maze umuherezi abituririre ku gicaniro c’ishikanwa rimota neza rinezereza Uhoraho . Uko aze abe ari ko umuherezi amutangira impongano, na we azoharirwa.
Naho niyatanga umwagazi w’intama kw’ikimazi c’icaha, aze atange iyivyara itagira agasembwa.
Aze arambike ikiganza ku mutwe w’ico kimazi hanyuma agikererere aho basanzwe bakererera ibimazi nk’ivyo bitangirwa ivyaha.
Hanyuma umuherezi aze yakire igice c’amaraso y’ico kimazi gitangiwe icaha, ayasigishe urutoke ku mahembe y’igicaniro co guturirirako ibimazi, asese ayasigaye hasi i ruhande y’igicaniro.

Aze akure ibinure vyose kuri ico kimazi nk’uko ibinure bisanzwe bikurwa ku mwagazi w’intama utanzwe kw’ikimazi c’ishimwe, hanyuma umuherezi abituririre ku gicaniro hejuru y’amashikanwa ashikanirwa Uhoraho . Uko ni ko umuherezi azomutangira impongano y’icaha yakoze, na we azoharirwa.
Umuntu niyahamagarwa ngo abe icabona, avuge ivyo yabonye canke azi, akanka kubivuga, bizomubera icaha, kandi ico caha aze agihanirwe.

Umuntu niyakora ku kintu gihumanye, nko ku muvyimba w’igikoko gihumanye caba ico mw’ishamba canke igitungano canke igikwega inda hasi, naho yoba atabimenye, azoba abaye uwuhumanye kandi azoba atsinzwe n’urubanza.
Canke umuntu niyakora ku bihumanya biva mu muntu, ibintu vyose bishobora gutuma umuntu ahumana, naho yoba atabizi, igihe azobimenyera azoba atsinzwe n’urubanza.
Umuntu niyasezerana canke akarahira atavyiyumviriye neza, akemera gukora ikintu, ari kibi canke ciza, naho yobigira atabizi, igihe azobimenyera azoba atsinzwe n’urubanza.
Umuntu niyashikirwa no gutsindwa n’urubanza mu buryo bumwe muri ubwo, aze yature ingene yacumuye,

hanyuma atange impongano y’icaha yakoze, ashikanire Uhoraho ishashi y’intama canke y’impene ivuye mu mukuku wiwe nk’ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha. Umuherezi na we aze ayimutangire kw’incungu y’icaha ciwe.

Niyaba adashobora kuronka umwagazi w’intama, aze ashikanire Uhoraho intunguru zibiri canke inuma zibiri nk’impongano y’icaha ciwe; imwe itangwe nk’ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha, iyindi itangwe nk’ikimazi co guturirirwa ku gicaniro.
Aze abizanire umuherezi, na we aze atangurire ku gutanga ikimazi c’ivyaha. Aze ahotore izosi ariko ntaritandukanye n’umutumba,

hanyuma aze amijagire igice c’amaraso y’ico kimazi gitangiwe ivyaha ku ruhande rumwe rw’igicaniro, ayandi maraso asigaye aze ayasese atembe hasi i ruhande y’igicaniro. Ico ni ikimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha.
Umuherezi aze aheze atange iya kabiri kw’ikimazi co guturirirwa ku gicaniro mu buryo bwashinzwe kugira ngo amutangire impongano y’icaha yakoze, na we azobabarirwa.

Ariko niyaba adashobora kuronka izo ntunguru canke izo numa, aze azane ic’icumi c’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ayitange kw’ikimazi gitangirwa icaha. Ntaze ayisukeko amavuta canke ngo ayishireko ibimota neza, kuko ari ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha.

Aze ayishire umuherezi, na we azoce akurako ifu yuzuye igipfunsi, nk’agace gatoya k’icibutso, ayituririre ku gicaniro hejuru y’amashikanwa yo guturirwa ashikaniwe Uhoraho . Izoba ibaye ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha.
Uko ni ko umuherezi azomutangira impongano y’icaha cose muri ivyo azoba yakoze, na we azobabarirwa. Ibisigaye kuri iryo shikanwa bizoba ari ivy’uwo muherezi, nk’uko bigenzwa ku mashikanwa y’ifu.’ ”
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:

“Umuntu niyacumura atabishaka agakora ikizira ku bijanye n’ivyera vy’ Uhoraho , aze ashikanire Uhoraho ikimazi c’indishi, kizobe ari impfizi y’intama akuye mu bitungwa vyiwe, arabe iyitagira agasembwa kandi igiciro cayo kizobe gikwiranye n’igiciro c’ifeza, ukoresheje ingero shekeli y’Ahera. Ico kizoba ari ikimazi c’indishi.

Ategerezwa kandi gusubiza agaciro ico kintu co mu vyera vy’Uhoraho yahumanije mu kwongerako ica gatanu c’igiciro caco. Aze abishikirize umuherezi, na we amaze kumutangira ico kimazi c’indishi, azoca ababarirwa.
Umuntu niyacumura ku cagezwe na kimwe c’ Uhoraho , naho atoba yabimenye, azoba ari uwo gutsindwa n’urubanza kandi azobihanirwa.

Aze ashire umuherezi impfizi y’intama akuye mu mukuku, itagira agasembwa kandi ifise igiciro gikwiye nk’uko bitegerezwa. Umuherezi aze amutangire ico kimazi c’indishi muri ubwo buryo, na we azobabarirwa.
Kizoba ari ikimazi c’indishi, kuko azoba yatsinzwe n’urubanza mu gucumura k’ Uhoraho .”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Umuntu niyacumura k’ Uhoraho mu guhemukira umubanyi wiwe, nk’akarorero akabesha ku vyerekeye ikintu yamugwatirije, yamutijije, yamwivye canke yamurenganije,
canke agatora ivyatakaye hanyuma ntamubwize ukuri ariko akarahira abesha, canke na ho agakora icaha co kuba icabona c’ibinyoma aho kuvugisha ukuri, canke agakora icaha ico ari co cose gisa n’ivyo;
niyacumura mu buryo na bumwe muri ubwo, azoba ashikiwe no gutsindwa n’urubanza. Aze asubize ico yivye canke yatwaye ku karenganyo, canke yari yagwatirijwe canke icari catakaye yatoye,
canke ico yari yarahiriye ibinyoma. Aze agisubize nyene co cose gikwiye, yongereko ica gatanu c’igiciro caco. Azogitange ku musi wo gutangirako ikimazi co gutunganya.
Mu gutanga ico kimazi c’indishi k’ Uhoraho , aze ashire umuherezi impfizi y’intama itagira agasembwa ivuye mu mukuku kandi ifise igiciro gikwiranye n’iyo ndishi.
Uko azobe ari ko umuherezi amutangira ikimazi imbere y’ Uhoraho , na we azobabarirwa ku co yakoze catumye aba uwo gutsindwa n’urubanza.”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:

“Barira Aroni n’abahungu biwe uti: ‘Aya ni yo mabwirizwa agenga ibimazi vyo guturirwa: Ikimazi co guturirwa kize kigume ku gicaniro ijoro ryose gushika mu gitondo, kandi umuriro uze ugume waka ku gicaniro.
Umuherezi aze yambare impuzu ziwe zera, n’impuzu zo musi zera, hanyuma akure umunyota w’ico kimazi camaze guturirwa n’umuriro ku gicaniro awushire i ruhande y’igicaniro.
Maze azoce akura za mpuzu yambare izindi, hanyuma asohore wa munyota awujane inyuma y’aho mucumbitse awushire mu kibanza kidahumanye.
Umuriro wo ku gicaniro uze ugume waka, ntuze uzime. Mu gitondo umuherezi aze yame yongerako inkwi yongere ashireko ikimazi co guturirwa, aturire n’ibinure vy’ikimazi c’ishimwe.
Umuriro uze ugume waka ku gicaniro, ntuze uzime.
Ibi ni vyo vyashinzwe ngo bigenge ishikanwa ry’ivyimburwa bivamwo ifu: Aroni n’abahungu biwe baze barishikanire Uhoraho imbere y’igicaniro.

Umuherezi aze ayore urushi rw’ifu inoze neza ayivange n’amavuta ya elayo hamwe n’ibimota neza, abijane ku gicaniro, hanyuma aturirire ku gicaniro ako gace kugira ngo kabe icibutso, ubumote bwiza bunezera Uhoraho .
Aroni n’abahungu biwe baze barye iyisigaye, ariko baze bayirye batayivanze n’umwambiro kandi bayirire mu kibanza cejejwe, mu rugo rw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.
Ntize ikaranganwe n’umwambiro. Ndayibahaye nk’umugabane wabo kuri ayo mashikanwa banshikanira. Nk’uko biri ku kimazi c’ivyaha n’ikimazi c’indishi, ico kimazi kizoba icejejwe cane.

Umuhungu wese ava mu ruvyaro rwa Aroni ashobora kukiryako. Uwo ni umugabane wiwe w’imisi yose ku mashikanwa yo guturirwa ashikaniwe Uhoraho uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi. Ikintu cose kizokora kuri iryo shikanwa kizoba cerejwe Uhoraho.’ ”
Uhoraho yongera kubwira Mose ati:

“Iri rize ribe ishikanwa Aroni n’abahungu biwe bazoshikanira Uhoraho ku musi bazoba barobanujwe amavuta: ic’icumi c’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza itangwa nk’ishikanwa ry’ifu ryama ritangwa ku musi, igice caryo aze agitange mu gitondo ikindi gice ku mugoroba.
Uze uyivange n’amavuta ya elayo hanyuma uyikarange kw’ipano, hanyuma ubizane bivanze neza bishikanwe nk’ishikanwa ry’ifu riri mu tumanyu dutoduto, ribe ubumote bwiza bunezera Uhoraho .
Umuhungu wiwe azomusubirira nk’umuherezi asizwe amavuta azobe ari we aritegura. Iryo ni ishikanwa rizokwamaho kandi ritegerezwa guturirwa ryose ntihagire igisigara.
Ishikanwa ry’ifu ritanzwe n’umuherezi rize riturirwe rihere; ntirize riribweko na gatoya.”
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:

“Bwira Aroni n’abahungu biwe uti: ‘Ibi ni vyo vyagezwe bigenga ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha: ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha kize gikerererwe imbere y’ Uhoraho aho ikimazi co guturirwa gikerererwa, kizoba ari icera cane.
Umuherezi agishikanye aze akirye, akirire mu kibanza cejejwe, mu rugo rw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Kandi ikintu cose kizokora ku nyama zaco kizoba kibaye icera, kandi amaraso yaco niyatarukira ku mpuzu, uze uyimesurire ahantu hera.
Inkono y’ibumba izoteka izo nyama izoce imenwa. Ariko nizatekwa mu nkono ikozwe mu mwakaka, ize yozwe hanyuma irongororwe mu mazi.
Umuhungu wese wo mu muryango w’uwo muherezi aze akiryeko; kizoba ari icera cane.
Ariko ikimazi c’ivyaha ntikize kiribwe igihe amaraso yaco azoba yazanywe mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro Ahera nk’ikimazi c’ivyaha. Kize giturirwe mu muriro.
Ibi ni vyo vyagezwe bigenga ikimazi c’indishi, kandi ni icera cane.
Ikimazi c’indishi kize gikerererwe ahategekanirijwe ico gikorwa, hanyuma amaraso yaco aze amijagirwe ku mpande zose z’igicaniro.
Ibinure vyaco vyose bize bishikanwe ku gicaniro: umurizo n’ibinure vyose bipfutse ivyo mu nda,
amafyigo yompi n’ibinure biri kuri yo n’ibiri ku mbavu hamwe n’igice cose gipfutse igitigu, ico azokuranako n’amafyigo.
Umuherezi aze abituririre ku gicaniro nk’ishikanwa ryo guturirwa rishikaniwe Uhoraho rituriwe mu muriro. Kizoba ari ikimazi c’indishi.
Umuhungu wese wo mu muryango w’uwo muherezi aze akiryeko, ariko baze bakirire ahantu hera, kuko kizoba ari icera cane.
Ivyagezwe vyerekeye ikimazi c’ivyaha n’ikimazi c’indishi birasa: ivyo bimazi vyose ni ivy’umuherezi yabitanze nk’ikimazi c’impongano.
Umuherezi atangiye umuntu ikimazi co guturirwa, urusato rwaco ruzoba urwiwe.
Ishikanwa ryose ry’ifu ryokejwe mw’ifuru canke rikaranzwe mw’isafuriya canke kw’ipano rizoba ari iryo umuherezi yaritanze,
kandi ishikanwa ryose ry’ifu, ryaba irivanze n’amavuta canke iritavanze, rizogabanganywa hagati y’abaherezi bakomoka kuri Aroni.
Ibi ni vyo vyagezwe vyerekeye ibimazi vy’ishimwe umuntu ashobora gushikanira Uhoraho :

Niyatanga ikimazi c’ishimwe mu buryo bwo gukenguruka, aze aherekeshe ico kimazi co gukenguruka udukate tutarimwo umwambiro tuvanze n’amavuta, n’udukate twamijagiweko amavuta tutarimwo umwambiro, n’udutsima dukozwe mw’ifu twacumbwe mu mavuta.
Ikimazi c’ishimwe co gukenguruka gitegerezwa kandi guherekezwa n’udukate turimwo umwambiro.
Aze ashikane kamwekamwe mu bwoko bwose nk’ingabire ihawe Uhoraho ; rizoba ari iryo umuherezi yamijagiye amaraso y’ivyo bimazi vy’ishimwe.
Inyama z’ico kimazi c’ishimwe co gukenguruka zize ziribwe kuri uwo musi catangiweko; ntihaze hagire izisigara ngo zishike mu gitondo c’uwundi musi.
Ariko ikimazi ciwe nicaba ari ico gushitsa isezerano canke ico atanze kuko avyishakiye, kize kiribwe ku musi gitangiweko, ariko izisigaye zishobora no kuribwa ku musi ukurikira.
Inyama zose z’ikimazi zizosigara gushika umusi ugira gatatu zize ziturirwe.

Nihagira inyama z’ikimazi c’ishimwe ziribwa ku musi ugira gatatu, uwagitanze ntazokwemerwa. Nta co kizomarira uwo muntu yagitanze, kuko kizoba gihumanye. Umuntu wese azorya kuri co azoba ari uwo gutsindwa n’urubanza.
Inyama zikoze ku kintu cose gihumanye ntizize ziribwe; zize ziturirwe. Nk’uko biri no ku zindi nyama, umuntu wese adahumanye aze arye izo nyama.
Ariko nihagira umuntu ahumanye arya ku nyama z’ikimazi c’ishimwe c’ Uhoraho , uwo muntu aze acibwe mu bwoko bwiwe.

Nihagira umuntu akora ku kintu na kimwe gihumanye; ari ibiva mu muntu bihumanya canke igikoko gihumanye canke ikindi kintu cose gihumanye gikwega inda hasi, hanyuma akarya ku nyama zo ku kimazi c’ishimwe c’ Uhoraho , uwo muntu aze acibwe mu bwoko bwiwe.’ ”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Barira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Ntimuze murye ikinure na kimwe caba ic’inka, ic’intama canke ic’impene.
Ibinure vy’igikoko gipfuye ata wucishe canke catabaguwe n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba mushobora kubikoresha ibindi, ariko ntimuze mubirye.
Umuntu wese azorya ibinure vyavuye mu kimazi co guturirwa gishikanirwa Uhoraho aze acibwe mu bwoko bwiwe.
Kandi aho muzoba muba hose, ntimuze murye amaraso y’inyoni canke igikoko na kimwe.
Nihagira umuntu arya amaraso, uwo muntu aze acibwe mu bwoko bwiwe.’ ”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Barira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Uwuzoshikanira Uhoraho ikimazi c’ishimwe aze ashikanire Uhoraho igice kimwe caco nk’ikimazi.
Aze akoreshe amaboko yiwe ubwiwe ashikane ikimazi co guturirwa, atange ibinure n’igikiriza, hanyuma azungagize ico gikiriza imbere y’ Uhoraho nk’ishikanwa ryo kuzungagiza.
Umuherezi aze aturirire ku gicaniro ivyo binure, ariko ico gikiriza ni ica Aroni n’abahungu biwe.
Muze muhe uwo umuherezi itako ry’i buryo ry’ibimazi vy’ishimwe ribe umugabane wiwe.
Umuhungu wa Aroni azotanga amaraso n’ibinure vy’ikimazi c’ishimwe aze ahabwe itako ry’i buryo ribe umugabane wiwe.
Ku bimazi vy’ishimwe vy’Abisirayeli, nahisemwo guha Aroni umuherezi n’abahungu biwe igikiriza co kuzungagiza n’itako ry’i buryo ngo bibe umugabane wabo w’intahava bazohabwa n’Abisirayeli.’ ”
Uyu ni wo mugabane wagenewe Aroni n’abahungu biwe uhereye igihe bazoba barobanuwe ngo bakorere Uhoraho nk’abaherezi.
Umusi basigwa amavuta, Uhoraho yategetse ko Abisirayeli babaha umugabane w’intahava uko urunganwe ruzokwama rukurikirana n’urundi.
Ibi ni vyo vyagezwe bigenga ibimazi vyo guturirwa, ibimazi vy’ifu, ibimazi vy’ivyaha, ibimazi vy’indishi, ikimazi co kurobanura n’ikimazi c’ishimwe,
ivyo Uhoraho yahaye Mose ku musozi Sinayi igihe yategeka Abisirayeli gushikanira Uhoraho ibimazi vyabo, mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi.
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Zana Aroni n’abahungu biwe, imyambaro yabo, amavuta yo kurobanura, ishuri y’ikimazi c’ivyaha, impfizi z’intama zibiri hamwe n’igiseke kirimwo imikate itarimwo umwambiro,
hanyuma ukoranirize ishengero ryose imbere y’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.”
Nuko Mose akora nk’uko Uhoraho yamubariye, hanyuma ishengero ryose rikoranira ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Mose abwira ikoraniro ati: “Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho yategetse ko bikorwa.”
Maze Mose azana Aroni n’abahungu biwe araboza n’amazi.
Yambika Aroni wa mwambaro usharijwe n’amabara, amukenyeza n’umukanda, yongera amwambika wa mutamana uri kumwe na efodi, iyo efodi aca arayimukenyeza akoresheje igitambara co gushariza.
Amwambika na ka gafuko ko mu gikiriza hanyuma agashiramwo Urimu na Tumimu.
Amwambika na ca gitambara mu mutwe agishirako ka gasharizo k’inzahabu kameze nk’ishurwe, nk’uko Uhoraho yategetse Mose.
Mose aca yakira ya mavuta yo kurobanura, ayarobanuza rya hema n’ibiri muri ryo vyose.
Amijagira ayo mavuta ku gicaniro incuro indwi, akirobanurira hamwe n’ibindi bikoresho vyaco vyose, na ca gikarabiro n’amaguru yaco na vyo arabirobanura.
Asuka ya mavuta yo kurobanura ku mutwe wa Aroni, amurobanurira igikorwa yatoranirijwe.
Hanyuma azana abahungu ba Aroni, abambika ya myambaro isharijwe n’amabara, abakenyeza ya mikanda, abambika na vya bitambara mu mitwe, nk’uko Uhoraho yabitegetse Mose.
Nuko azana ya shuri y’ikimazi c’ivyaha, Aroni n’abahungu biwe barambika ibiganza vyabo ku mutwe wayo.

Mose aca akerera iyo shuri, afata igice c’amaraso yayo ayasigisha urutoke ku mahembe y’igicaniro kugira ngo agihumanure, ayasigaye ayasuka i ruhande y’igicaniro. Uko ni ko yarobanuye ico gicaniro kugira ngo aceze.
Mose aca afata ibinure vyose bipfutse ivyo mu nda, igice gipfutse igitigu, amafyigo yompi n’ibinure biri kuri yo, abituririra ku gicaniro.
Ariko ibisigaye vy’iyo shuri, urusato n’inyama n’amayezi abituririra hirya y’aho bari bacumbitse, nk’uko Uhoraho yabitegetse Mose.
Aca azana ya mpfizi y’intama y’ikimazi co guturirwa, Aroni n’abahungu biwe barambika ibiganza vyabo ku mutwe wayo.
Mose aca akerera iyo mpfizi y’intama amaraso yayo ayamijagira ku mpande zose z’igicaniro.
Aca afata ya mpfizi y’intama ayihimbaguramwo ibihimba, ivyo bihimba aca abituririra hamwe n’umutwe n’ibinure.

Amaze kwoza n’amazi ivyo mu nda n’amaguru, aca aturirira ya mpfizi y’intama yose ku gicaniro nk’ikimazi co guturirwa, ikimazi kimota neza, ishikanwa rishikaniwe Uhoraho rituriwe n’umuriro, nk’uko Uhoraho yabitegetse Mose.
Hanyuma Mose aca azana ya mpfizi y’intama yindi, imwe yo kurobanura, Aroni n’abahungu biwe bayirambika ibiganza ku mutwe.
Mose aca akerera iyo mpfizi y’intama asiga igice c’amaraso yayo ku gutwi kw’i buryo kwa Aroni, ku rukumu rw’ikiganza c’i buryo no kw’ino rikuru ry’ikirenge c’i buryo.
Mose aca azana n’abahungu ba Aroni abasiga ya maraso ku matwi y’i buryo, ku nkumu no ku mano makuru vy’i buryo, hanyuma aca amijagira ayasigaye ku mpande zose z’igicaniro.
Aca afata ibinure vyo ku murizo, ibinure bipfutse ivyo mu nda, igice gipfutse igitigu, amafyigo yompi n’ibinure biri kuri yo n’itako ry’i buryo.
Hejuru y’ivyo aca ashirako umukate utarimwo umwambiro, umukate ucumbanywe n’amavuta n’akandi gakate gatogato, ayikuye mu giseke c’imikate itarimwo umwambiro kiri imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Vyose aca abishira mu biganza vya Aroni n’ivy’abahungu biwe, babishikanira Uhoraho mu kubizunguza nk’uko bigenda mu migenzo yo gushikanira Uhoraho .
Hanyuma Mose abikura mu minwe yabo abituririra ku gicaniro hejuru y’ishikanwa rituririwe kurobanura, ishikanwa rimota neza, rishikaniwe Uhoraho rituriwe n’umuriro.
Mose afata igikiriza arakizunguza agishikiriza Uhoraho . Ico ni co cari igice c’iyo ntama yo kurobanura yari agenewe, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabimutegetse.
Hanyuma Mose yakira ku mavuta yo kurobanura no ku maraso ari ku gicaniro abimija Aroni n’imyambaro yiwe yongera abimija abahungu biwe n’imyambaro yabo.

Mose abarira Aroni n’abahungu biwe ati: “Nimuteke inyama zisigaye, muzitekere imbere y’umuryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro, muzirire aho nyene muzikoze imikate iri muri ca giseke c’imikate y’amashikanwa yo kurobanura, nk’uko nategetse, aho navuga nti: ‘Aroni n’abahungu biwe baze babirye.’
Hanyuma ibisigara kuri izo nyama no kuri iyo mikate biturirwe.
Ntimuze muve ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro, muze muhamare imisi indwi, kuko kurobanurwa kwanyu kuzomara imisi indwi.
Ivyo twakoze vyose uwu musi, ni vyo Uhoraho yategetse kugira ngo mutangirwe ikimazi c’ivyaha vyanyu.
Muze mugume ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro ku murango no mw’ijoro gushika imisi indwi iheze, mukore ivyo Uhoraho yategetse kugira ngo ntimupfe, kuko uko ari ko nategetswe.”
Nuko Aroni n’abahungu biwe bakora vyose nk’uko Uhoraho yabibategetse abicishije kuri Mose.
Ku musi ugira umunani, Mose ahamagara Aroni n’abahungu biwe n’abakuru barongoye Abisirayeli.
Abarira Aroni ati: “Fata ishuri yo gutangwa nk’ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha vyawe, ufate n’impfizi y’intama itangwa nk’ikimazi co guturirwa, zose zibe izitagira agasembwa, uzizane imbere y’ Uhoraho .

Hanyuma ubarire Abisirayeli uti: ‘Mufate isuguru y’impene itangwa nk’ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha; inyana n’umwagazi w’intama, vyose bimaze umwaka umwe kandi zitagira agasembwa, vyo gutangwa nk’ikimazi giturirwa,
muzane n’ishuri, n’impfizi y’intama vyo gutangwa kw’ikimazi c’ishimwe gitangirwa imbere y’ Uhoraho , hamwe n’ishikanwa ry’ifu ivanze n’amavuta, kuko uwu musi Uhoraho agira abiyereke.’ ”
Maze baca bafata vya bintu vyose nk’uko Mose yabibategetse babizana imbere y’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, kandi ikoraniro ryose riregera rihagarara imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Maze Mose arababwira ati: “Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho yabategetse gukora, kugira ngo ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho bubone kubabonekera.”

Mose abwira Aroni ati: “Niwegere igicaniro, utange ikimazi c’ivyaha vyawe hamwe n’ico guturirwa kugira ngo witangire ikimazi co kugucungura wewe n’ubwoko bwose; wongere utange ikimazi c’ihanga ryose kugira ngo ubatangire ikimazi co kubacungura, nk’uko Uhoraho yategetse.”
Nuko Aroni yegera igicaniro akerera ya shuri y’ikimazi c’ivyaha vyiwe.
Abahungu biwe bamuzanira amaraso, akozamwo urutoke rwiwe muri ayo maraso aca ayasiga ku mahembe y’igicaniro, ayasigaye ayasesa hasi hambavu y’igicaniro.
Aca aturirira ku gicaniro ibinure, amafyigo n’igice gipfutse igitigu vya ca kimazi c’ivyaha, nk’uko Uhoraho yategetse Mose.
Inyama n’urusato abituririra hirya y’aho bacumbitse.
Hanyuma aca akerera ca kimazi co guturirwa. Abahungu biwe bamuzanira amaraso, ayasesa hirya no hino y’igicaniro.
Bamuhereza ca kimazi bagiciyemwo ibikenye, harimwo n’umutwe, abituririra ku gicaniro.
Hanyuma yoza ivyo mu nda n’amaguru abituririra ku gicaniro, hejuru ya ca kimazi caturiwe.
Nuko Aroni azana ca kimazi gitangirwa ihanga ryose. Afata ya mpene y’ikimazi c’ivyaha vyabo arayikerera ayitanga kw’ikimazi c’ivyaha nk’uko yari yabikoze kuri kimwe ca mbere c’ivyaha vyiwe.
Azana na ca kimazi co guturirwa agitanga nk’uko vyategetswe.
Aca azana na rya shikanwa ry’ifu, ayora ifu yuzuye urushi ayituririra ku gicaniro hamwe n’ikimazi co guturirwa co mu gitondo.
Akerera ya shuri na ya mpfizi y’intama vy’ikimazi c’ishimwe c’iryo hanga. Abahungu biwe bamuhereza amaraso, ayamijagira hirya no hino y’igicaniro.
Ariko imigabane y’ibinure vy’iyo shuri n’iyo mpfizi y’intama: umurizo, ibinure bipfutse ivyo mu nda, amafyigo n’igice gipfutse igitigu,
vyose abiremeka ku bikiriza vy’ivyo bitungwa bibiri, maze Aroni aturirira ivyo binure vyavyo ku gicaniro.
Aroni azungagiza ivyo bikiriza n’amatako y’i buryo imbere y’ Uhoraho nk’ishikanwa ryo kuzungagiza, nk’uko Mose yabitegetse.
Nuko Aroni aterura amaboko ayarabisha ku bantu bose arabahezagira. Amaze gutanga ikimazi c’ivyaha, ico guturirwa n’ic’amahoro, arururuka ava ku gicaniro.
Mose na Aroni baca binjira mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro. Bavuyeyo, bahezagira abantu bose, maze ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho bubonekera abantu bose.
Umuriro uva imbere y’ Uhoraho utongora ca kimazi co guturirwa na ya migabane y’ibinure vyari ku gicaniro. Abantu bose babonye ivyo, barasemerera bavuza urwamo rw’umunezero baca bubama hasi.
Abahungu ba Aroni, Nadabu na Abihu, bakira ivyotezo vyabo, babishirako umuriro bashirako n’ibimota neza; baca bakoresha umuriro utemewe n’ Uhoraho , ntibakurikiza uko yabitegetse.
Maze umuriro uvuye imbere y’ Uhoraho urarurumba urabatongora, bapfira rimwe aho nyene imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Mose abwira Aroni ati: “Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho yatubwira igihe yavuga ati: ‘Ku bantu begera aho ndi, nzokwiyerekana ndi Uwera; imbere y’amaso y’abantu bose, nzokwihesha icubahiro.’ ” Aroni araceceka.
Mose ahamagara Mishayeli na Elizafani, abahungu ba Uziyeli sewabo wa Aroni, arababwira ati: “Nimuze hano, mutware benewanyu inyuma y’aho abantu bacumbitse, mubigize kure y’ahera.”
Baraza babaterura uko bakambaye ya myambaro yabo isharijwe n’amabara, babajana inyuma y’aho bacumbitse, nk’uko Mose yategetse.

Maze Mose abwira Aroni n’abahungu biwe Eliyazeri na Itamari ati: “Ntimureke umushatsi wanyu udashokoje, kandi ntimwitabagurireko impuzu, kuko mwoca mupfa kandi Uhoraho agashavurira ihanga ryose. Ariko incuti zanyu, ihanga ryose ry’Abisirayeli, baze bagandarire abo Uhoraho yaranduje umuriro.
Ntimuve imbere y’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro kugira ngo ntimupfe, kuko amavuta yo kurobanura y’ Uhoraho ari kuri mwebwe.” Nuko bakora nk’uko Mose yavuze.
Hanyuma Uhoraho abwira Aroni ati:

“Wewe n’abahungu bawe ntimuze mwigere munywa umuvinyu canke ikindi kinyobwa cose kirimwo umwambiro imbere y’uko muja mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro, kuko mwoca mupfa. Iki kize kibe icagezwe c’intahava uko urunganwe ruzokurakuranwa n’urundi,
kugira ngo muze mushobore gutandukanya ivyera n’ibisanzwe, ibihumanye n’ibidahumanye,
kandi muze mwigishe Abisirayeli amabwirizwa yose Uhoraho yabahaye abicishije kuri Mose.”

Mose abwira Aroni n’abahungu biwe basigaye ari bo Eliyazeri na Itamari ati: “Mwakire ishikanwa ry’ifu ryasigaye ku mashikanwa, mukore imikate muyizane imbere y’ Uhoraho , hanyuma muyirire i ruhande y’igicaniro, ariko ntibe irimwo umwambiro kuko ari iyera cane.
Muyirire ahantu hejejwe, kuko ari umugabane wanyu n’uw’abahungu banyu ku bimazi bishikanirwa Uhoraho , kuko ari ko nategetswe.

Ariko wewe n’abahungu n’abakobwa bawe mushobora kurya igikiriza cazungagijwe, hamwe n’itako, mukabirira ahantu hadahumanye. Bihawe wewe n’abana bawe nk’umugabane uvuye ku bimazi vy’ishimwe bitangwa n’Abisirayeli.

Itako n’igikiriza, bize bizanane n’imitigiri y’ibinure y’ibimazi vyo guturirwa, kugira ngo bizungagizwe imbere y’ Uhoraho nk’ishikanwa ryo kuzungagiza. Uwo uze ube umugabane wanyu w’intahava mwebwe n’abana banyu, nk’uko Uhoraho yategetse.”
Maze Mose abajije ivyerekeye ya suguru y’impene y’ikimazi c’ivyaha vy’abantu bose, akamenya ko yaturiwe, aca ashavurira Eliyazeri na Itamari, abahungu ba Aroni bari basigaye, arababaza ati:
“Ni kuki mutaririye ico kimazi co gutangirwa ivyaha ahantu hera? Ni icera cane, mwari mwagihawe ngo gikureho icaha c’ihanga mu kubabera ikimazi c’ivyaha imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Kubera yuko amaraso yaco yari yajanywe Ahera, mwari kuba mwariye iyo mpene mukayirira mw’ihema, nk’uko nari nabitegetse.”

Aroni yishura Mose ati: “Uyu musi batanze ikimazi c’ivyaha vyabo n’ikimazi co guturirirwa imbere y’ Uhoraho , ariko raba ivyambayeko. Mbega Uhoraho yari guhimbarwa iyo mba nariye ku kimazi gitangirwa ivyaha vy’ihanga uwu musi?”
Mose yumvise ivyo, aca yumva aranyuzwe.
Uhoraho abwira Mose na Aroni ati:
“Barira Abisirayeli muti: ‘Mu bikoko vyose biba mu gihugu, ibi ni vyo mwemerewe kurya:
mwemerewe kurya igikoko cose gifise ikinono gisatuye kandi cuza ivyo cariye.
Hariho bimwe vyuza gusa canke bifise ikinono gisatuye gusa: ivyo ntimuze mubirye. Ingamiya, naho yuza ntifise ikinono gisatuye; irahumanye kuri mwebwe.
Inkezi naho yuza, ntifise ikinono gisatuye; irahumanye kuri mwebwe.
Agakwavu naho kuza ntigafise ikinono gisatuye; karahumanye kuri mwebwe.
Ingurube naho ifise ibinono bisatuye, ntiyuza; na yo irahumanye kuri mwebwe.
Ntimuze murye inyama zavyo canke ngo mukore ku mivyimba yavyo; ivyo birahumanye kuri mwebwe.
Mu biba mu mazi yo mu biyaga no mu nzuzi vyose, mwemerewe kurya ibifise amababa n’ibigaragamba.
Ariko ibiba mu mazi yo mu biyaga no mu nzuzi bitagira amababa n’ibigaragamba, vyaba ibigendera hamwe canke ibindi vyose biba mu mazi, muze mubigire umuziro.
Kandi ko ari ibizira kuri mwebwe, ntimuze mubirye kandi ntimuze mukore no ku mivyimba yavyo.
Ikintu cose kiri n’ubuzima kiba mu mazi ariko kidafise amababa n’ibigaragamba kirahumanye kuri mwebwe.
Ibi ni vyo muzofata nk’ibihumanye mu biguruka mu kirere kandi ntimuze mubirye kuko ari ibihumanye kuri mwebwe: inkona, ikinyakabaka, inkukuma,
ikinyamwanira, icaruzanyoni nk’uko amoko yavyo ari,
ubwoko bwose bw’ibikona,
ikigendabunyovu, sarumfune, inguriguri, n’amoko yose y’ubuca;
igihuna, ikirovyi, inyanana,
ikinyamwanira, inkongori, ikiryamivyimba,
agasoza, ubwoko bwose bw’inyange, samunsure, n’agahungarema.
Udukoko twose dufise amababa tukagendera ku maguru ane tuze tube uduhumanye kuri mwebwe.
Ariko hariho udukoko tumwetumwe tuguruka tukagendera no ku maguru ane mushobora kurya: ni udufise amaguru afatanye n’ikirenge dushobora gusimbagurika kw’isi.
Muri ivyo muze murye ubwoko bwose bw’inzige, ibihori canke intoteza.
Ariko udukoko twose tundi tuguruka dufise amaguru ane tuzoba duhumanye kuri mwebwe.
Umuntu wese azokora ku muvyimba w’utwo dukoko dutuma muhumana azoba ahumanye gushitsa ku mugoroba.
Uwuzotwara umuvyimba watwo ategerezwa kumesa impuzu ziwe, azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Igikoko cose kidafise ikinono gisatuye canke kituza kirahumanye kuri mwebwe; kandi uwuzokora ku muvyimba wa kimwe muri vyo azoba ahumanye.
Ibikoko vyose bifise amaguru ane ariko bitagira ibinono birahumanye kuri mwebwe. Uwuzokora ku muvyimba wa kimwe muri vyo azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Uwuzokora ku muvyimba wa kimwe muri vyo ategerezwa kumesa impuzu ziwe, kandi azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba. Ivyo bikoko birahumanye kuri mwebwe.
Mu bikoko vyose bikwega inda hasi, ibi ni vyo bihumanye: ifuku, imbeba, ubwoko bwose bw’imiserebanyi,
icugu, ikivumbura, umuserebanyi mutoya, agacamano n’uruvuruvu.
Mu bikwega inda hasi vyose, ivyo ni vyo bizira kuri mwebwe. Umuntu azokora ku muvyimba wavyo azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.

Nihagira kimwe muri vyo gipfa kigakorokera ku kintu gikoreshwa, ico gikoresho, ico ari co cose, kizoba gihumanye, caba igikozwe mu giti, mu mpuzu, mu rusato canke mw’igunira, muze mugishire mu mazi; kize kigume gihumanye gushika ku mugoroba, hanyuma kizoba gihumanutse.
Nihagira igikorokera mu nkono y’ibumba, ibizoba biri muri yo vyose bizoba bihumanye, kandi muze mumene iyo nkono.
Ivyokurya vyose mwemerewe kurya bimaze gukorwako n’amazi yavuye muri iyo nkono bizoba bihumanye, kandi ibinyobwa vyose bizoba bivuye muri iyo nkono bizoba bihumanye.
Ikintu cose umuvyimba wavyo uzogwako kizoba gihumanye; iziko canke inkono iteka bize bimenagurwe. Bizoba bihumanye, kandi muze mubifate nk’ibihumanye.
Ariko niyaba ari isoko y’amazi canke ikinogo co kubikamwo amazi bizoguma ari ibidahumanye; ariko nihagira uwuzokora kuri uwo muvyimba azoba ahumanye.
Umuvyimba niwakorokera ku mbuto zo guterwa, zizoguma ari izidahumanye.
Ariko uwo muvyimba niwagwa ku mbuto zinitswe mu mazi, zizoba zihumanye kuri mwebwe.
Nihagira igikoko mu vyo mwemerewe kurya gipfa, umuntu wese azokora ku muvyimba waco azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.

Umuntu wese azorya kuri uwo muvyimba aze amesure impuzu ziwe, kandi aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba. Uwuzoterura uwo muvyimba aze amesure impuzu ziwe, kandi aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Igihumeka cose gikwega inda hasi kize gifatwe nk’igihumanye, ntikize kiribwe.
Ntimuze murye ikintu na kimwe gikwega inda hasi, caba igikwega inda hasi canke ikigendera ku maguru ane canke ayarenga; ni igihumanye.
Ntimuze mwihumanishe ivyo vyaremwe.
Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu, muze mwiyeze mube abera, kuko nanje ndi uwera. Ntimuze mwiyandurishe na kimwe muri ivyo vyaremwe bikwega inda hasi.
Ndi Uhoraho , nabakuye muri Egiputa ngo ndababere Imana; nuko rero mube abera, kuko nanje ndi uwera.
Ayo ni yo mategeko agenga ibikoko, inyoni, ikintu cose gihumeka kigendagenda mu mazi n’ikigendagenda kw’isi.
Muze mutandukanye ibizira n’ibitazira, ivyemewe kuribwa mu bihumeka n’ibitemewe kuribwa.’ ”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Barira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Umugore niyasama inda hanyuma akavyara umuhungu azoba ahumanye kumara imisi indwi, nk’uko aba ahumanye iyo yagiye mu miziro y’abagore.
Ku musi ugira umunani uwo muhungu aze akebwe agakoba gapfutse umutwe w’igitsina ciwe.

Hanyuma uwo mugore aze arindire imisi mirongo itatu n’itatu hanyuma aheze ahumanurwe kubera amaraso yavuye mu kwibaruka. Ntaze akore ku kintu na kimwe cejejwe canke ngo aje mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro iyo misi yo guhumanurwa kwiwe itarahera.

Niyavyara umukobwa, uwo mugore azomare amayinga abiri ahumanye, nk’uko biri mu gihe ari mu miziro y’abagore. Aze arindire imisi mirongo itandatu n’itandatu kugira ngo ahumanurwe kubera amaraso yavuye mu kwibaruka.

Iyo misi yo guhumanurwa niyahera, haba ku muhungu canke ku mukobwa, aze ashire umuherezi umwagazi w’intama umaze umwaka umwe, awumuhere imbere y’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro ube ikimazi co guturirwa, amuhane n’agaswi k’inuma isanzwe canke intunguru kugira ngo bibe ikimazi c’ivyaha.

Uwo muherezi aze abishikanire Uhoraho kugira ngo bibere ikimazi gicungura uwo mugore, na we azoba ahumanuwe kubera amaraso yavuye. Ivyo ni vyo vyagezwe vyerekeye umugore yavyaye umuhungu canke umukobwa.

Niyaba adashobora kuronka umwagazi w’intama, aze atange inyoni zitwa intunguru zibiri canke inuma zikiri nto zibiri, inyoni imwe izoba ikimazi co guturirwa, iyindi na yo ibe ikimazi c’ivyaha. Uko ni ko umuherezi azotangira impongano uwo mugore, na we azoba ahumanuwe.’ ”
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni ati:
“Umuntu niyaba afise ikibibi canke igisekera canke ikivyimba ku mubiri wiwe gishobora kuvamwo imibembe, baze bamushire Aroni canke umwe mu bana biwe azoba ari umuherezi.

Uwo muherezi aze asuzume ico kintu kiri ku mubiri, niyasanga ubwoya buri muri ico kibibi bwahindutse bukera kandi n’ico kibibi na co nyene cimburutse, izoba ari imibembe. Uwo muherezi amaze kumusuzuma aze amenyeshe ko uwo muntu acitse uwuhumanye.
Ico kibibi nicaba cera ariko kitimburutse kandi ubwoya buri muri co ntibwere, uwo muherezi aze ashire uwo muntu ahantu ha wenyene ahamare imisi indwi.
Ku musi ugira indwi uwo muherezi aze asubire amusuzume, niyasanga ico kibibi kitahindutse kandi kitagutse, aze asubire amushire ahantu ha wenyene iyindi misi indwi.

Ku musi ugira indwi aze asubire kandi amusuzume. Ico kibibi nicaba cagabanutse nticiyongere ku mubiri, uwo muherezi aze amenyeshe ko uwo muntu adahumanye; kizoba ari ikibibi gisanzwe. Uwo muntu aze amesure impuzu ziwe, aheze abe ahumanuwe.
Ariko ico kibibi niciyongera ku mubiri inyuma y’uko umuherezi azoba yamaze kumenyesha ko adahumanye, aze agaruke kubonana n’umuherezi.
Uwo muherezi aze amusuzume, ico kibibi nicaba caragutse, aze amenyeshe ko ahumanye; izoba ari imibembe.
Umuntu wese azoba agwaye ingwara yo ku rukoba, baze bamushire umuherezi.
Umuherezi aze amusuzume, niyasanga ahari ikibibi hera kandi n’ubwoya bwo muri ico kibibi bwahindutse bukera hakaba hanavyimvye,
izoba ari imibembe yamufashe. Umuherezi azoce amenyesha ko ahumanye. Ntaze arinde kumushira ahantu ha wenyene ngo amusuzume, kuko azoba yari asanzwe amaze guhumana.
Iyo ngwara niyaba yakwiye umubiri wose, aho umuherezi agarukiriza amaso hose, kuva ku mutwe gushika ku birenge,

uwo muherezi aze amusuzume, asanze iyo ngwara ikwiye umubiri wiwe wose, aze amenyeshe ko iyo ngwara idatuma umuntu aba uwuhumanye, hanyuma amenyeshe ko uwo muntu adahumanye. Kuko umubiri wiwe wose wahindutse ukera, azoba adahumanye.
Ariko igihe habonetse igisebe gishasha kuri we, azoba ahumanye.
Umuherezi niyabona ico gisebe gishasha, aze yihute kumenyesha ko ahumanye kuko igisebe kiba gihumanye; azoba agwaye imibembe.
Ico gisebe nicahinduka kikera, azoce aja ku muherezi.
Uwo muherezi aze amusuzume, niyasanga ico gisebe cahindutse kikera, uwo muherezi azoce amenyesha ko adahumanye; azoba ahumanutse.
Umuntu niyagira igisebe ku mubiri kigakira,
hanyuma ahari ico gisebe hakaboneka ikivyimba cera canke igishunduri cera canke gishaka gutukura, aze yiyereke umuherezi.
Uwo muherezi aze ahasuzume, niyasanga himburutse kandi ubwoya bwaho bwahindutse bukera, uwo muherezi aze ace amenyesha ko uwo muntu ahumanye; izoba ari imibembe yadutse muri ya nkovu.
Ariko umuherezi niyahasuzuma agasanga ubwoya bwaho ntibwera kandi ntihimburutse kandi humye, uwo muherezi aze amushire ahantu ha wenyene imisi indwi.
Aho hantu nihakomeza kuba hanini, umuherezi aze amenyeshe ko uwo muntu ahumanye; izoba ari imibembe.
Ariko nihaba ata cahindutse kandi hatabandanije kuba hanini, izoba ari inkovu gusa ivuye ku gisebe, umuherezi aze amenyeshe ko uwo muntu adahumanye.
Umuntu niyagira ubushe ku mubiri wiwe maze hakaboneka ibara ryera canke ryera rishaka gusa n’agahama,

umuherezi aze ahasuzume, niyasanga ubwoya bwaho bwahindutse bukera, kandi himburutse, izoba ari imibembe izoba yafatiye muri ya nkovu y’ubushe. Uwo muherezi aze amenyeshe ko uwo muntu ahumanye; izoba ari imibembe.
Ariko niyamusuzuma agasanga ubwoya bwaho butera, hatimburutse kandi humye, uwo muherezi azoce amushira ahantu ha wenyene imisi indwi.
Ku musi ugira indwi umuherezi aze amusuzume. Niyasanga habandanije haba hanini, uwo muherezi azoce amenyesha ko uwo muntu ahumanye; izoba ari imibembe.
Ariko niyasanga ata cahindutse kandi hatabaye hanini ariko humye, izoba yari inkovu y’ubushe gusa, uwo muherezi aze amenyeshe ko uwo muntu adahumanye; izoba yari inkovu gusa y’ubushe.
Umugabo canke umugore niyafatwa n’igisekera mu mutwe canke ku gasakanwa,

umuherezi aze asuzume ico gisekera, niyasanga carimburutse kandi ubwoya canke umushatsi uri muri co wahindutse ugasa n’umuhondo kandi ari mutomuto cane, uwo muherezi aze amenyeshe ko uwo muntu ahumanye; bizoba ari ibinyoro, bifatira mu mutwe canke ku gasakanwa.
Ariko uwo muherezi niyasuzuma ico gisekera, agasanga nticasebuye kandi ata mushatsi wirabura urimwo, uwo muherezi aze ashire uwo muntu ahantu ha wenyene imisi indwi.
Ku musi ugira indwi uwo muherezi aze asuzume ico gisekera, nicaba kitabandanije kiba kinini, ata bwoya bw’umuhondo buri muri co,
baze bamumwe ariko ahagwaye bahareke, hanyuma uwo muherezi amusubize ha hantu ha wenyene iyindi misi indwi.

Ku musi ugira indwi umuherezi aze asuzume ca gisekera, nicaba kitabandanije kiba kinini kandi kitimburutse, umuherezi aze amenyeshe ko uwo muntu adahumanye. Aze amesure impuzu ziwe, aho azoba yejejwe.
Ariko nicabandanya caguka umuherezi amaze kumenyesha ko yahumanutse,
umuherezi aze amusuzume, asanze caragutse, uwo muherezi ntaze arinde kuraba ko umushatsi usa n’umuhondo; uwo muntu azoba ahumanye.
Ariko niyasuzuma agasanga nta cahindutse kandi haratanguye kumera umushatsi wirabura, ico gisekera kizoba kiriko kirakira. Azoba ahumanutse, kandi umuherezi aze amenyeshe ko uwo muntu adahumanye.
Umugabo canke umugore niyagira ibibara vyera ku mubiri,
umuherezi aze abisuzume. Ivyo bibara nivyaba vyera buhorobuhoro, izoba ari ingwara isanzwe yo ku rukoba; uwo muntu ntazoba ahumanye.
Umugabo avungutse umushatsi akagira ubuhanza, ntazoba ahumanye.
Avungutse umushatsi w’imbere akagira ubuhanza imbere, ntazoba ahumanye.
Ariko muri ubwo buhanza hagati canke mu ruhanga nihaza igisebe cera kandi kigomba gutukura, izoba ari imibembe yamufashe ku mutwe canke mu ruhanga.
Umuherezi aze amusuzume, niyasanga ico gisebe cera kandi kigomba gutukura nk’imibembe,
uwo muntu azoba agwaye kandi azoba ahumanye. Uwo muherezi aze amenyeshe ko uwo muntu ahumanye kubera ico gisebe kiri ku mutwe.
Umuntu azoba afise imibembe nk’iyo aze yambare impuzu zitabaguritse, ntaze asokoze umushatsi wiwe, kandi aze yipfuke ku munwa agende arasemerera ati: ‘Ndahumanye! Ndahumanye!’
Aze agume ahumanye igihe cose azoba akigwaye. Azobe ukwiwe, inyuma y’aho mucumbitse.
Impuzu yose izojako ifira, yaba iyikozwe mu bwoya bw’intama canke iyijishwe mu nyuzi zera derere,
yaba impuzu ijishwe mu bwoya bw’intama canke mu nyuzi zera, haba ku nsato canke ikintu cose gikozwe mu rusato,
iryo fira ribonetse ku mpuzu, ku rusato, ku mwambaro ujishwe, canke ku gikozwe mu rusato, niryaba risa n’urwatsi rubisi canke ritukura, rizoba ari ifira rikwiye gusuzumwa n’umuherezi.
Umuherezi aze asuzume iryo fira kandi ashire ico kintu ririko ukwa conyene imisi indwi.

Ku musi ugira indwi aze agisuzume, niyasanga iryo fira ryagwiriye kuri iyo mpuzu, canke uwo mwambaro canke ico gitambara, canke urwo rusato, ico ari co cose gikoreshwa, izoba ari ingwara y’imibembe; ico kintu kizoba gihumanye.

Aze aturire iyo mpuzu, canke ico gitambara canke uwo mwambaro ujishwe mu bwoya bw’intama canke mu nyuzi zera, canke icakozwe mu rusato candukiwe n’iyo ngwara. Kubera ko iyo mibembe idashobora gukurwa muri ico kintu, kize giturirwe.
Ariko, umuherezi niyagisuzuma, agasanga rya fira ritabandanije rigwira kuri iyo mpuzu, ico gitambara canke uwo mwambaro, canke ico kintu gikozwe mu rusato,
aze ategeke ko ico gikoresho kimesurwa. Hanyuma aze asubire agishire ahantu ha conyene iyindi misi indwi.

Ico gikoresho kimaze kumesurwa, umuherezi aze asubire agisuzume, niyasanga iryo fira ritahindutse uko ryari risanzwe risa, naho ritoba ryagwiriye, ico gikoresho kizoba gihumanye, muze mugiturire, naho uwo mubembe woba wafatiye ku ruhande rumwe canke urundi.
Uwo muherezi niyagisuzuma, agasanga rya fira ryumye ico gikoresho kimaze kumesurwa, aze atabure ico gice c’iyo mpuzu canduye, canke c’urwo rusato, c’ico gitambara canke c’uwo mwambaro ujishwe.

Ariko niryasubira kuboneka kuri iyo mpuzu, kuri uwo mwambaro ujishwe, kuri ico gitambara canke ku cakozwe mu rusato, iryo fira rizoba ryagwiriye, bazoce baturira ico kintu kizoba gifise iryo fira ico ari co cose.
Iyo mpuzu, uwo mwambaro ujishwe, ico igitambara canke ico kintu gikozwe mu rusato cari camesuwe kigakurwako iryo fira, kize gisubire kimesurwe ubwa kabiri, kugira ngo kibe igihumanutse.

Ivyo ni vyo vyagezwe bigenga ivyandukijwe n’ifira, vyaba ari impuzu zikozwe mu bwoya bw’intama canke mu nyuzi zera, ibitambara, imyambaro ijishwe canke ikintu cose gikozwe mu rusato, kugira ngo bimenyekane ko bihumanye canke bidahumanye.”

headings.text: Ivyagezwe vyerekeye ingwara zo ku rukoba

verses.text: Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Ibi ni vyo vyagezwe bigenga uguhumanurwa kw’umunyamibembe, igihe azoba aje imbere y’umuherezi:
Uwo muherezi aze aje inyuma y’aho bacumbitse aheze amusuzume. Uwo muntu niyaba yakize imibembe,
umuherezi aze avuge ko bamuzanira ivyo guhumanura uwo akwiye guhumanurwa: inyoni zibiri zidahumanye kandi zibona, igiti c’isederi, ubwoya bw’intama bwasizwe irangi ritukura n’ishami rya ezobu.
Hanyuma umuherezi aze ategeke ko bakererera imwe muri izo nyoni hejuru y’amazi meza ari mw’ibesani ikozwe mw’ibumba.
Hanyuma aze afate ya nyoni ikibona ayibize muri ya mazi arimwo ya maraso ya ya nyoni yakererwa, hamwe na ca giti c’isederi, na bwa bwoya bw’intama na ya ezobu.
Aze amijagire ayo maraso incuro indwi kuri wa muntu akwiye guhumanurwa imibembe yiwe, ace yatura ko ahumanuwe. Aze aheze arekure ya nyoni ibona yigurukire mu kirere.

Uwo muntu ahumanuwe azoce amesa impuzu ziwe, yimoshe umushatsi wose kandi yoge umubiri wose; aho azoba ahumanutse. Ivyo biheze ashobora kugaruka aho mucumbitse, ariko aze agume hanze ntaze yinjire mw’ihema ryiwe imisi indwi idaheze.

Ku musi ugira indwi aze yimoshe umushatsi wose; aze akure umushatsi wo ku mutwe wiwe, ubwanwa bwiwe, ingohe zo ku maso yiwe, n’ubwoya aho buri hose ku mubiri, aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyoge umubiri wose, aho azoba ahumanutse.

Ku musi ugira umunani aze ashikane imyagazi ibiri y’intama y’isuguru imaze umwaka, hamwe n’umwagazi w’intama uvyara umwe umaze umwaka, kandi yose izobe itagira agasembwa, ayishikane iri kumwe na bitatu vya cumi vy’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ivanze n’amavuta bibe ikimazi c’ifu hamwe n’ingero logi imwe y’amavuta.
Umuherezi ajejwe kumuhumanura aze ashire imbere y’ Uhoraho uwo muntu ahumanurwa hamwe n’amashikanwa yiwe imbere y’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.
Umuherezi aze afate umwe muri iyo myagazi y’intama y’isuguru awutangeko ikimazi c’indishi, hamwe na ya ngero logi y’amavuta; aze abizungagize imbere y’ Uhoraho nk’ishikanwa ryo kuzungagiza.
Aze akererere uwo mwagazi ahera aho basanzwe bakererera ibimazi vy’ivyaha n’ibimazi vyo guturirwa. Nk’uko bigenda ku kimazi c’ivyaha, ikimazi c’indishi ni ic’umuherezi; kandi ni icera cane.

Umuherezi aze afate amwe ku maraso y’ikimazi c’indishi ayasige ku gutwi kw’i buryo kw’uwo muntu akwiye guhumanurwa, ku rukumu rwo ku kiganza ciwe c’i buryo no kw’ino rikuru ry’ikirenge ciwe c’i buryo.
Hanyuma umuherezi aze yakire kuri ya ngero logi amavuta make ayasuke mu kiganza ciwe c’i bubamfu,
akozemwo urutoke rwiwe rukurikira urukumu rw’ikiganza ciwe c’i buryo, ace ayamijagira n’urwo rutoke incuro indwi imbere y’ Uhoraho .

Umuherezi aze afate amavuta asigaye muri ca kiganza ciwe ayasige ku gutwi kw’i buryo kw’uwo muntu akwiye guhumanurwa, no ku rukumu rwiwe rw’i buryo no kw’ino rikuru ryiwe ry’i buryo, hejuru y’aho yasize ya maraso ya ca kimazi c’indishi.
Amavuta azosigara mu kiganza azoce ayasiga ku mutwe w’uwo muntu akwiye guhumanurwa, amutangire ikimazi co kumucungura imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Inyuma y’ivyo, umuherezi aze atange ca kimazi c’ivyaha co gucungura uwo akwiye guhumanurwa, kugira ngo ntagume ahumanye. Umuherezi aze akerere ico kimazi co guturirwa,
ace agitanga ku gicaniro, hamwe na rya shikanwa ry’ifu, amutangire ikimazi kimucungura, na we azoba ahumanuwe.

Ariko niyaba ari umukene adashobora kuronka ivyo, azoshikane umwagazi w’intama umwe w’impfizi ube ikimazi c’indishi, ishikanwa ryo kuzungagiza kugira ngo ribe ikimazi co kumucungura. Azowushikane uri kumwe n’ic’icumi c’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ivanze n’amavuta nk’ishikanwa ry’ifu hamwe n’ingero logi imwe y’amavuta,
intunguru zibiri zikiri nto canke inuma, ivyo ashobora kuronka; kimwe kizoba ari ikimazi c’ivyaha, ikindi kizoba ari ikimazi co guturirwa.
Ku musi ugira umunani, aze abishire umuherezi kugira ngo abone guhumanurwa, abimushikirize mu rwinjiriro rw’ihema ry’ibonaniro, imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Uwo muherezi aze yakire wa mwagazi w’intama w’ikimazi c’indishi na ya ngero logi y’amavuta, abizungagize imbere y’ Uhoraho nk’ishikanwa ryo kuzungagiza.

Aze akerere uwo mwagazi w’ikimazi c’indishi, ace afata amaraso yawo, amwe ayasige ku gutwi kw’i buryo kw’uwukwiye guhumanurwa, ku rukumu rwiwe rw’ikiganza c’i buryo no kw’ino rikuru ry’ikirenge c’i buryo.
Uwo muherezi aze asuke ayo mavuta mu kiganza ciwe c’i bubamfu,
ace amijagira ayo maraso incuro indwi imbere y’ Uhoraho n’urutoke rwiwe rukurikira urukumu.

Aze afate amavuta makeya kuri ayo ari mu kiganza c’i bubamfu ayashire hamwe yashira amaraso ya ca kimazi c’indishi: ku gutwi kw’i buryo, ku rutoke rw’urukumu rw’ikiganza c’i buryo no kw’ino rikuru ry’ikirenge c’i buryo.
Ayasigaye kuri ayo mavuta ari mu kiganza c’i bubamfu uwo muherezi aze ayasige ku mutwe wa wa muntu akwiye guhumanurwa, kugira ngo amutangire ikimazi co kumucungura imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Inyuma y’ivyo aze ashikane twa duswi tw’inuma canke tw’intunguru, ivyo uwo muntu ashoboye kuronka,

kamwe agatange nk’ikimazi c’ivyaha akandi agatange nk’ikimazi co guturirwa, hamwe na rya shikanwa ry’ifu. Uko ni ko uwo muherezi azotanga ishikanwa ryo kwicungura imbere y’ Uhoraho , aritangiye uwo akwiye guhumanurwa.”
Ivyo ni vyo vyagezwe bigenga umuntu wese azoba yagwaye imibembe ariko akaba adashobora kuronka vya bimazi vyategetswe kugira ngo ashobore guhumanurwa.
Uhoraho abwira Mose na Aroni ati:
“Nimwashika i Kanani, igihugu ngiye kubaha ngo kibe icanyu, ngateza ifira mu nzu kanaka muri ico gihugu,
nyene iyo nzu aze agende abimenyeshe umuherezi ati: ‘Nabonye igisa n’ifira mu nzu yanje.’

Uwo muherezi aze asabe bakuremwo ibintu isigare igaragara imbere y’uko aja gusuzuma iryo fira, kugira ngo ntihagire na kimwe co muri iyo nzu kivugwa ko gihumanye. Hanyuma y’ivyo, umuherezi aze agende agendure iyo nzu.
Aze asuzume iryo fira ku mpome, niyasanga iryo fira rifise utunogonogo dusa n’urwatsi rubisi canke dutukura kandi dusa n’utwimburutse mu ruhome,
uwo muherezi aze asohoke aciye mu muryango w’iyo nzu, ace yugara iyo nzu imisi indwi.
Ku musi ugira indwi, uwo muherezi aze agaruke gusuzuma iyo nzu. Niyasanga iryo fira ryatandukiriye ahandi ku mpome,
aze ategeke bakureho amabuye yafashwe n’iryo fira, bace bayata mu kibanza gihumanye inyuma y’igisagara.
Aze asabe baharagure impome zose ku ruhande rw’imbere bace bata ivyo bivunguka mu kibanza gihumanye inyuma y’igisagara.
Hanyuma baze barondere ayandi mabuye yo gusubiriza ya yandi n’ivyo guhoma bishasha bisubirira ivyaharaguwe.
Iryo fira niryasubira kuboneka muri iyo nzu kandi bakuyeho amabuye n’ivyari bihomye kuri yo bakabisubiriza n’ibindi,
uwo muherezi aze asubire agende ayisuzume. Niyasanga iryo fira ryagwiriye mu nzu, izoba ari imibembe; iyo nzu izoba ihumanye.
Iyo nzu ize isamburwe. Amabuye yayo, imbaho zayo n’ivyo bakoresheje mu kuyihoma, bize bisamburwe bitabwe inyuma y’igisagara ahantu hahumanye.
Umuntu wese azokwinjira iyo nzu mu gihe izoba yugawe azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Umuntu wese azorira canke akarara muri iyo nzu aze amesure impuzu ziwe.
Ariko wa muherezi niyaza kuyisuzuma agasanga iryo fira ritabandanije rigwira bamaze kuyisiga bushasha, aze avuge ko iyo nzu idahumanye, kuko iryo fira rizoba ryaheze.
Mu guhumanura iyo nzu aze azane inyoni zibiri n’igiti c’isederi, n’ubwoya bw’intama busize irangi ritukura, hamwe na ezobu.
Aze akererere imwe muri izo nyoni hejuru y’ibesani ikozwe mw’ibumba irimwo amazi meza.

Hanyuma aze afate ca giti c’isederi, ya ezobu na bwa bwoya bw’intama busize irangi ritukura, na ya nyoni ibona, avyibize muri ya maraso ya ya nyoni yakererwa avanze na ya mazi meza, hanyuma amijagire iyo nzu incuro indwi.
Aze ahumanuze iyo nzu amaraso ya ya nyoni, ya mazi meza, ya nyoni ibona, ca giti c’isederi, ezobu na bwa bwoya bw’intama busizwe irangi ritukura.
Aze aheze arekure ya nyoni ibona yigurukire inyuma y’igisagara. Uko ni ko azotanga ikimazi co gucungura iyo nzu, na yo izoba ihumanuwe.”
Ivyo ni vyo vyagezwe bigenga ubwoko bwose bw’imibembe, ibinyoro,
ifira mu mpuzu canke mu nzu,
ibihute, ibisekera n’ibibara,
kugira ngo vyerekane ko ikintu gihumanye canke kidahumanye. Ivyo ni vyo vyagezwe bigenga ingwara zo ku rukoba no mu mpuzu.
Uhoraho abwira Mose na Aroni ati:
“Bwira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Umugabo niyafatwa n’ingwara yo mu bihimba vy’irondoka, ibimuvamwo vyose bizoba bihumanye.
Igihe cose bizoba bikiza biva mu mubiri wiwe canke vyazibiwe, uwo muntu azoba ahumanye. Uku ni ko ivyo bimuvamwo bizotuma umuntu ahumana:
Uburiri bwose uwo muntu azoryamako buzoba buhumanye, n’ikintu cose azokwicarako kizoba gihumanye.
Umuntu wese azokora kuri ubwo buriri aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Umuntu wese azokwicara ku kintu na kimwe uwo muntu yicayeko aze amesure impuzu ziwe kandi yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Umuntu wese azokora kuri uwo muntu aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Uwo muntu agwaye niyacira ku muntu yari asanzwe adahumanye, uwo yaciriyeko aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Ikintu cose uwo muntu agwaye azokwicarako ari kw’ifarasi kizoba gihumanye,

kandi umuntu wese azokora kuri ivyo bintu vyose vyari musi yiwe azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba; uwuzoterura ikintu na kimwe muri ivyo aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Umuntu wese uwo mugwayi azokorako adakaravye n’amazi aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Inkono y’ibumba yose uwo mugwayi azokorako ize imenagurwe, kandi nicaba ari igikoresho gikozwe mu giti ico ari co cose kize cozwe n’amazi.
Umuntu niyakira iyo ngwara yamutera ubuhumane, aze aharure imisi indwi imbere yo guhumanurwa. Niyahera aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi meza, azoba ahumanuwe.
Ku musi ugira umunani aze atware intunguru zibiri zikiri nto canke inuma zikiri nto azishikane imbere y’ Uhoraho mu bwinjiriro bw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro abihe umuherezi.
Umuherezi aze abitangeko ibimazi, kimwe kibe ikimazi c’ivyaha, ikindi kibe ikimazi co guturirwa. Azoba atangiye uwo muntu ikimazi co kwicungura imbere y’ Uhoraho kubera ivyamuvuyemwo.
Umugabo niyasesa imbuto ziwe mw’ijoro, aze yiyuhagire umubiri wose n’amazi, aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Impuzu yose canke ikintu cose gikozwe mu rusato izo mbuto zashitseko kize kimesurwe n’amazi, kandi kizoba gihumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Umugabo niyaryamana n’umugore hakaba gusohora imbuto, baze biyuhagire n’amazi, kandi bazoba bahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Umugore niyaja mu miziro yiwe, azoba ahumanye imisi indwi, kandi umuntu wese azomukorako azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Ico azoryamako cose akiri mu miziro yiwe kizoba gihumanye, kandi ico azokwicarako cose kizoba gihumanye.
Uwuzokora ku buriri yaryamyeko aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Umuntu wese azokora ku kintu na kimwe uwo mugore yicayeko aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Bwaba uburiri canke ikintu cose yicayeko, nihagira umuntu agikorako, azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Nihagira umugabo aryamana n’uwo mugore maze amaraso amuvamwo ku bw’iyo miziro yiwe agakora kuri uwo mugabo, azoba ahumanye imisi ndwi, mbere n’uburiri bwose azoryamako buzoba buhumanye.
Umugore niyaguma ava amaraso imisi myinshi mu gihe ciwe c’imiziro, canke niyaba aguma ava amaraso kurenza ukwezi kwiwe, azoguma ahumanye imisi yose bizomara, nk’uko bigenda igihe ari mu kwezi kwiwe.

Uburiri bwose azoryamako igihe azoba ari muri ivyo bihe buzoba buhumanye, ni co kimwe n’uburiri bwiwe aryamako mu gihe c’ukwezi kwiwe, kandi ikintu cose azokwicarako kizoba gihumanye, nk’uko bimeze mu gihe c’ukwezi kwiwe gusanzwe.
Kandi umuntu wese azobikorako azoba ahumanye. Aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi azoguma ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Kuva amaraso nivyahagarara, aze aharure imisi ndwi, niyahera azoba ahumanutse.
Ku musi ugira umunani aze azane intunguru zibiri zikiri nto, inuma zibiri zikiri nto azizanire umuherezi imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Uwo muherezi aze abitange, kimwe kibe ikimazi c’ivyaha, ikindi kibe ikimazi co guturirwa. Aho ni ho azoba amutangiye ikimazi co kumucungura imbere y’ Uhoraho kubera ubuhumane yatewe n’ayo maraso.
Muze murinde Abisirayeli ibintu vyose vyobahumanya, kugira ngo ntibapfe bazize ubwo buhumane kuko bohava bahumanya inzu yanje yera iri hagati muri bo.’ ”
Ivyo ni vyo vyagezwe bigenga ibiva mu bihimba vy’irondoka, yaba umugabo yahumanijwe n’uko yasohoye imbuto ziwe,
yaba umugore ari mu kwezi kwiwe, yaba umugabo canke umugore bagwaye mu bihimba vy’irondoka, bigatuma bava ibintu bibahumanya, canke umugabo yaryamanye n’umugore asanzwe ahumanye.
Uhoraho yaravuganye na Mose inyuma y’urupfu rwa ba bahungu babiri ba Aroni bapfuye igihe begera Uhoraho bafise umuriro utari wo imbere yiwe.

Uhoraho abwira Mose ati: “Bwira mukuru wawe Aroni ntaze yinjire uko yishakiye Ahera Cane inyuma ya ca gihuzu gikingiriye imbere ya wa mupfundikizo batangirako ibimazi vyo kwicungura uri kw’Isandugu y’Isezerano, kugira ngo ntapfe; kuko nzobonekera mu gicu hejuru ya wa mupfundikizo utangirwako ikimazi co gucungura.
Uku ni ko Aroni azokwinjira Ahera Cane: azoshikane ishuri kw’ikimazi c’ivyaha n’impfizi y’intama kw’ikimazi co guturirwa.

Aze yambare umwambaro wiwe wera ujishe mu nyuzi zera derere, hamwe n’ibutura rijishe muri izo nyuzi nyene ngo ahishe ubwambure bwiwe; aze akenyeze wa mukanda wo mu nyuzi zera derere, yambare na ca gitambara cera derere. Izo ni impuzu zera; ni co gituma azobanza kwiyuhagira n’amazi imbere y’uko azambara.
Aze ashikane n’isuguru z’impene zivuye mu Bisirayeli kw’ikimazi c’ivyaha n’impfizi y’intama kw’ikimazi co guturirwa.
Aroni aze atange iyo shuri kw’ikimazi c’ivyaha vyiwe kugira ngo yitangire ishikanwa we n’umuryango wiwe.
Hanyuma aze afate za suguru z’impene azizane imbere y’ Uhoraho ku muryango w’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.
Aze akoreshe ubupfindo kuri izo mpene kugira ngo amenye iyegukira Uhoraho n’iyo gutabwa mu bugaragwa.
Aroni aze afate iyo ubupfindo bweguriye Uhoraho ayitange kw’ikimazi c’ivyaha.
Ariko iyerekanywe ko ari iyo gutabwa mu bugaragwa izozanwe imbere y’ Uhoraho ikiri nzima kugira ngo ikoreshwe nk’ikimazi co gucungura bazorungika mu bugaragwa nk’impene yo gutabwa.
Aroni aze ashikane ya shuri kw’ikimazi ciwe c’ivyaha kugira ngo yitangire ikimazi ku gatwe kiwe n’abiwe, aheze ayikerere ibe ikimazi c’ivyaha vyiwe.
Aze yakire ico kwokoza amakara yaka avuye ku gicaniro imbere y’ Uhoraho ayore amashi abiri y’ifu inoze y’ibimota neza kandi ikaranze, hamwe n’ibimota neza ace avyinjirana inyuma ya ca gihuzu gikinze.

Aze ashire ivyo bimota neza kuri wa muriro imbere y’ Uhoraho , hanyuma umwotsi uvuye muri ivyo bimota neza uzotwikira wa mupfundikizo utangirwako ikimazi co gucungura uri kw’Isandugu y’Isezerano, na we ntazoheza ngo apfe.

Aze ajane no ku maraso y’iyo shuri ace ayamijagira n’urutoke kuri wa mupfundikizo ku ruhande ruhera mu buseruko; aze ayamijagire kandi n’urutoke nyene incuro indwi imbere y’uwo mupfundikizo utangirwako ikimazi co gucungura.

Hanyuma azoce akerera ya mpene y’ikimazi c’ivyaha c’abantu, atware amaraso yayo inyuma ya ca gihuzu gikingiriye ayakoreshe nk’uko yakoze kuri ya yandi ya ya shuri: Azoyamijagire ku mupfundikizo utangirwako ikimazi co gucungura n’imbere yawo.

Ni muri ubwo buryo azotangira Ahera Cane ikimazi co gucungura kubera ubuhumane n’ubugarariji bw’Abisirayeli, uko ivyaha vyabo vyongana kwose. Aze agire atyo no ku bw’ihema ry’ibonaniro, kuko riri hagati muri bo, hagati mu buhumane bwabo.
Ntihaze hagire umuntu n’umwe yinjira mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro kuva igihe Aroni azoba yinjiye Ahera Cane gushika asohotse, amaze kwitangira impongano yiwe, iy’abo mu nzu yiwe hamwe n’iy’Abisirayeli bose.
Hanyuma aze asohoke aje ku gicaniro kiri imbere y’ Uhoraho agitangire ikimazi na co nyene. Aze afate ku maraso ya ya shuri no ku ya ya suguru y’impene ayasige ku mahembe y’ico gicaniro.
Aze amijagire ayo maraso kuri co n’urutoke rwiwe incuro indwi kugira ngo agihumanure yongere aceze ubuhumane bwose bw’Abisirayeli.
Maze Aroni niyaheza gutangira impongano Ahera Cane, n’ihema ry’ibonaniro hamwe n’igicaniro, aze azane ya mpene ikibona.

Aze ayirambikeko ibiganza vyiwe vyompi ku mutwe yaturire kuri yo ukugabitanya n’ubugarariji bw’Abisirayeli, ivyaha vyabo vyose, abiremeke ku mutwe w’iyo mpene. Ahejeje azoce ayirungika mu bugaragwa ijanwe n’umuntu yatoranirijwe gukora ico gikorwa.
Iyo mpene izokwiremeka ivyaha vyabo vyose ibitware ahantu hatagira abantu; uwo muntu aze aheze ayirekurire mu bugaragwa.
Aroni azoce asubira yinjire mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro akure za mpuzu zera derere yambara imbere y’uko yinjira Ahera Cane, azisigeyo,

hanyuma yiyuhagirire n’amazi ahantu hera ace yambara impuzu ziwe zisanzwe. Azoce asohoka atange ca kimazi co guturirwa ciwe na ca kimazi co guturirwa c’abantu bose, kugira ngo yitangire ikimazi we ubwiwe hamwe n’abantu bose.
Azoce aturirira ku gicaniro ibinure vyavuye kuri ca kimazi c’ivyaha.
Wa muntu yatwara ya mpene yo gutabwa mu bugaragwa agarutse aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi; hanyuma ashobore kuja aho mucumbitse.

Ya shuri na ya suguru zatangwa nk’ibimazi vy’ivyaha, amaraso yavyo akajanwa Ahera Cane kugira ngo atangweko ikimazi co gucungura, bize bijanwe inyuma y’aho mucumbitse maze insato zavyo, inyama zavyo n’ivyo mu nda bize biturirwe.
Umuntu azobiturira aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, abone kugaruka aho mucumbitse.

Iri rize ribe ibwirizwa rihoraho kuri mwebwe: ku musi ugira icumi w’ukwezi kw’indwi muze mwisonzeshe kandi ntihagire igikorwa na kimwe mukora, yaba uwavukiye muri mwebwe canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe,
kuko kuri uwo musi hazoba gucungurwa kwanyu, kugira ngo muhumanurwe. Namwe muzoba mwejejwe ivyaha vyanyu vyose.
Izoba ari Isabato y’ukuruhuka, muze muwuruhukeko kandi mwisonzeshe; iri rize ribe ibwirizwa rihoraho.
Umuherezi yasizwe amavuta kandi yatoranirijwe gusubirira se wiwe nk’umuherezi mukuru ni we azotanga ikimazi co gucungura. Aze yambare za mpuzu zera derere,
atange ikimazi co gucungura Ahera Cane, ihema ry’ibonaniro, igicaniro, abaherezi n’abantu bose.
Iri rize ribe ibwirizwa rihoraho kuri mwebwe: ico kimazi co gucungura kizohora gitangwa rimwe mu mwaka gitangirwe ivyaha vyose vy’Abisirayeli.” Nuko baca bakora nk’uko Uhoraho yategetse Mose.
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Vugana na Aroni n’abahungu biwe n’Abisirayeli bose ubabwire uti: ‘Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho yategetse:
Umwisirayeli wese azotangira ikimazi c’ishuri, umwagazi w’intama canke w’impene aho mucumbitse canke inyuma yaho,

aho kukizana ku muryango w’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro ngo agitange nk’ikimazi gishikaniwe Uhoraho imbere y’Ihema ry’ Uhoraho , uwo muntu azokwagirwa n’icaha co gusesa amaraso; azoba yasheshe amaraso kandi azoce acibwa mu muryango wiwe.

Iki cagezwe gitegeka Abisirayeli guhora bazanira Uhoraho ibimazi bahora batangira aho ari ho hose. Baze babizanire umuherezi, ni ko kubishikanira Uhoraho , imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro babitange nk’ibimazi vy’ishimwe.
Umuherezi aze amijagire amaraso ku gicaniro c’ Uhoraho imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro, bace baturira ibinure nk’umubabwe umota neza uhimbara Uhoraho .
Ntibaze basubire gutanga ibimazi vyabo babishikanira imana z’impene izo bihumanishije mu kwifatanya na zo. Iri rize ribe itegeko ry’intahava kuri bo uko urunganwe ruzokurakuranwa n’urundi.’
Nuko ubabwire uti: ‘Umwisirayeli wese canke umunyamahanga aba muri bo azotanga ishikanwa rituriwe canke ikimazi
atakizanye imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro ngo agishikanire Uhoraho , uwo muntu aze acibwe mu bwoko bwiwe.
Umwisirayeli wese canke umunyamahanga aba muri bo azorya amaraso, igitsure canje kizoba kuri uwo muntu arya amaraso kandi nzomukura mu bantu banje.
Kuko ubuzima bw’icaremwe buri mu maraso yaco, kandi nayabahaye kugira ngo ababere ikimazi co ku gicaniro co kubacungura; amaraso ni yo aba ikimazi c’ubuzima bw’umuntu.
Ni co gituma mbwiye Abisirayeli nti: “Ntihaze hagire umuntu n’umwe wo muri mwebwe canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe azorya amaraso.”
Umwisirayeli wese canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe azohiga igikoko ico ari co cose canke inyoni ishobora kuribwa aze asese amaraso yose hanyuma ayarenzeko ivu,

kuko ubuzima bw’icaremwe cose ari amaraso yaco. Ni co gituma mbwiye Abisirayeli nti: “Ntimuze murye amaraso y’icaremwe na kimwe, kuko ubuzima bw’icaremwe cose ari amaraso yaco. Uwuzoyarya wese aze akurwe mu bantu.”

Umuntu, yaba imvukira canke umunyamahanga, azorya ikintu yasanze capfuye canke catabaguwe n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba, aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, ashishikare kuba uwuhumanye gushika ku mugoroba; aheze abe ahumanuwe.
Ariko natamesura impuzu ziwe ngo yiyuhagira n’amazi, azobiharurwako nk’ukugabitanya.’ ”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze mukore nk’uko mwahora mukora muri Egiputa, aho mwahora muba, kandi ntimuze mukore nk’uko bakora mu gihugu c’i Kanani, aho ngiye kubinjiza. Ntimuze mwigane ivyo bakora.
Muze mwumvire ivyagezwe vyanje, mwitondere ivyo ndabategetse. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Muze mwitondere ivyo nashinze n’ivyagezwe vyanje, kuko umuntu wese azovyitondera azobeshwaho na vyo. Ndi Uhoraho .
Ntihaze hagire umuntu yegera incuti yiwe ya hafi ngo barangurane amabanga mpuzabitsina. Ndi Uhoraho .
Ntuze umaramaze so mu kuryamana na nyoko. Ni umuvyeyi wawe; ntuze uryamane na we.
Ntuze uryamane n’umugore wa so; kuko ni ukumaramaza so.
Ntuze uryamane na mushikawe, yaba uwo musangiye so gusa canke uwo musangiye nyoko gusa, yaba ari uwavukiye muri iyo nzu canke uwavukiye ahandi.
Ntuze uryamane n’umwuzukuru wawe, yaba uwo ku muhungu canke uwo ku mukobwa; ivyo ni ibiterasoni.
Ntuze uryamane n’umukobwa w’umugore wa so, uwo so yavyaranye na we; kuko ni mushikawe.
Ntuze uryamane na mushiki wa so, kuko ari incuti ya so ya hafi.
Ntuze uryamane n’umuvukanyi wa nyoko, kuko ari incuti ya nyoko ya hafi.
Ntuze umaramaze sowanyu mu kuryamana n’umugore wiwe; kuko ari nyogosenge kuri wewe.
Ntuze uryamane n’umukazana wawe, kuko ari umugore w’umuhungu wawe; ntuze uryamane na we.
Ntuze uryamane na muramwawe; kuko kwoba ari ukumaramaza umuvukanyi wawe.
Ntuze uryamane n’umugore ngo wongere uryamane n’umukobwa wiwe. Kandi, ntuze uryamane n’umwuzukuru wiwe wo ku muhungu canke wo ku mukobwa; kuko ari incuti ziwe za hafi. Ico ni ikizira.
Ntuze uharike umugore wawe, umuharikishije uwo bavukana, ngo uryamane na we umugore wawe akiriho.
Ntuze uryamane n’umugore ari mu miziro yiwe.
Ntuze uryamane n’umugore wa mugenzawe ngo umwihumanishe.
Ntuze utange umwana wawe ngo atangwe kw’ikimazi c’ikigirwamana Moleki, kuko ukwiye kwirinda ngo ntukengere izina ry’Imana yawe. Ndi Uhoraho .
Ntuze uryamane n’umugabo nk’uko baryamana n’umugore. Ico ni ikintu co kwankwa urunuka.
Ntuze uryamane n’igikoko ngo uciyandurishe. Ntihaze hagire umugore yitega igikoko ngo kiryamane na we; ni ubuhumane butavugwa.
Ntimuze mwiyanduze mu buryo na bumwe muri ubwo bwose, kuko uko ari ko amahanga ngiye gusohora mu gihugu ngiye kubinjiza biyanduje.
Igihugu ubwaco caranduye; ni co gituma nagihanye kubera icaha caco, hanyuma na co gica kidahwa abakibamwo bose.
Ariko mwebwe muze mwitondere ivyo nabategetse vyose n’ivyo nashinze. Yaba imvukira canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe, ntimuze mukore ibintu nk’ivyo vyo kwankwa urunuka,
kuko ivyo vyose vyakorwa n’amahanga yaba muri ico gihugu imbere yanyu, bituma ico gihugu gihumana.
Nimwahumanya ico gihugu, kizobadahwa nk’uko cadashwe amahanga yariho imbere yanyu.
Umuntu wese azokora na kimwe muri ivyo bintu vyo kwankwa urunuka aze akurwe mw’ihanga ryiwe.
Muze mwitondere ivyo ndabasaba ntimuze mukurikire ingeso mbi n’ivyo bakora imbere y’uko muza, kugira ngo ntimwihumanishe izo ngeso. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.’ ”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Vugana n’ishengero ryose ry’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Mube abera kuko jewe, Uhoraho Imana yanyu, ndi uwera.
Umuntu wese aze yubahe se na nyina, kandi aze yubahirize amasabato yanje. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze muhindukirire ibigirwamana canke ngo mwikorere ibigirwamana mu butare buvugutiwe mu muriro. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Nimwashikanira Uhoraho ikimazi c’ishimwe, muze mugitange neza ku buryo butuma mwemerwa.
Kize kiribwe ku musi mwagitangiyeko canke ku musi ukurikira; ibizoba bisigaye vyose gushika ku musi wa gatatu bize biturirwe.
Nihagira ikintu na kimwe kiribwa ku musi wa gatatu, kizoba gihumanye kandi ntikizokwemerwa.
Umuntu wese azokiryako azotsindwa n’urubanza rw’uko yahumanije ivyera vy’ Uhoraho ; uwo muntu aze acibwe mu bwoko bwiwe.
Nimwimbura ibivuye mu ndimiro zanyu, ntimuze mutware ivyamereye inyuma y’urubibe rwanyu canke ngo musubire inyuma gutora ivyo mwibagiriye mu mirima.
Ntimuze musubire mu ruzabibu rwanyu ubugira kabiri canke ngo mutore imbuto z’imizabibu zakorokeye hasi. Muze mubisigarize umukene n’inyambukira. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimukibe. Ntimukabeshe. Ntimugahendane.
Ntimuze murahire ibinyoma, kugira ngo mwoye guhumanya izina ryanje; ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntuze urenganye canke ngo wibe muganzawe. Ntuze urare udahemvye umukozi wakoresheje.
Ntuze uvume igipfamatwi canke ngo ushire igitsitaza imbere y’impumyi: wubahe Imana yawe. Ndi Uhoraho .
Ntimuze muce imanza zigoramye mu guhengamira ku muntu ngo ni uko ari umugorwa canke ari umukuru, ahubwo mucire bagenzi banyu imanza z’ukuri.
Ntimuze mugende muravuga nabi bagenzi banyu. Ntimuze mukore ikintu gishobora gushira mu kaga k’urupfu bagenzi banyu. Ndi Uhoraho .
Ntuze ugirire urwanko mu mutima wawe abo mu bwoko bwanyu. Ariko uze wihanize mugenzawe ariko arakora ikibi kugira ngo ntuhave usangira na we icaha ciwe.
Ntuze wihore canke ngo ugumanire inzigo uwo mu bwoko bwanyu, ariko uze ukunde mugenzawe nk’uko wikunda. Ndi Uhoraho .
Muze mwitondere ivyo nategetse. Ntimuze mubangurire ibikoko ku bindi bidahuje ubwoko. Ntimuze mutere mu mirima yanyu imbuto z’ubwoko bubiri. Ntimuze mwambare impuzu zijishwe mu nyuzi z’ubwoko bubiri.
Umugabo niyaryamana n’umwigeme w’umugurano arehejwe n’uwundi ariko ataracungurwa canke ngo aronke ukwidegemvya, aze ahanwe bikwiye. Ariko ntibaze bicwe, kuko uwo mwigeme atari bwaronke umwidegemvyo.
Ariko uwo mugabo we, aze ashikanire Uhoraho impfizi y’intama imbere y’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, impfizi y’intama y’ikimazi c’indishi gishikanirwa Uhoraho .
Umuherezi aze amutangire ikimazi imbere y’ Uhoraho akoresheje ico kimazi co kwikurako icaha, kubera icaha yakoze, na we azoharirwa icaha ciwe.
Nimwashika mu gihugu mugatera igiti c’icamwa ico ari co cose, muze mumare imyaka itatu mufata ko ivyamwa vyaco ari ibizira; ntibize biribwe.
Umwaka ugira kane, ivyamwa vyaco bizoba ari ivyera, ishikanwa ryo guhimbaza Uhoraho .
Ariko mu mwaka ugira gatanu muremerewe kurya ivyamwa vyaco. Nimwakora uko, ni ho umwimbu wanyu uzogwira. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze murye inyama zikirimwo amaraso. Ntimuze mukoreshe ivy’ubupfumu no guhamagara imizimu.
Ntimuze mumwe umushatsi wo mu misaya yanyu canke ubwanwa bwanyu.
Ntimuze mwikebagure ku mibiri yanyu kubera abapfuye canke ngo mwishushanyeko ibintu ku mibiri. Ndi Uhoraho .
Ntimuze mutetereze umukobwa wanyu mu kumushorera mu bumaraya, kuko vyohava bikwegera igihugu kwuzura ubumaraya n’ubundi bubi.
Muze mwitondere amasabato yanje kandi mwubahe ahera hanje. Ndi Uhoraho .
Ntimuze muhindukirire abahamagara imizimu canke abanyamareba, kuko bobanduza. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Uze uhaguruke kubera icubahiro c’umutama, wubahe abakuruta kandi uhe icubahiro Imana yawe. Ndi Uhoraho .
Umuntu w’umunyamahanga niyaba muri mwebwe, ntimuze mumufate nabi.
Umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe aze afatwe nk’imvukira. Mumukunde nk’uko mwikunda, kuko mwari inyambukira muri Egiputa. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze mukoreshe ingero zidakwiye iyo muriko murapima uburebure, uburemere canke ubwinshi.
Muze mukoreshe iminzane itabesha, ingero efa ikwiye n’ingero hini y’ukuri. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu, nabakuye mu gihugu ca Egiputa.
Muze muzigame amategeko n’amabwirizwa yanje yose mwongere muyitondere. Ndi Uhoraho .’ ”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:

“Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Umwisirayeli canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe azotanga umwe mu bana biwe ngo ashikanirwe ikigirwamana Moleki aze yicwe. Abantu b’ubwoko bwanyu baze bamwicishe amabuye.
Igitsure canje nzogishira kuri uwo muntu kandi nzomukura mu bwoko bwiwe; kuko azoba ahumanije ahera hanje kandi atukishije izina ryanje, mu gutanga abana biwe kw’ibimazi vya Moleki.
Abantu nibirabira hirya igihe uwo muntu azotanga umwe mu bana biwe kuri Moleki ntibamwice,
nzohindukiriza igitsure canje kuri abo bantu n’imiryango yabo kandi nzobakura mu bwoko bwabo. Ivyo bizoba kuri we no ku bamukurikira mu kwihumanisha ico kigirwamana Moleki.
Igitsure canje kizoba ku muntu wese ahamagara imizimu n’abapfumu akihumanisha kuvyizigira no kubikurikira. Nzomuca mu muryango wiwe.
Mwitange mube abera, kuko ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
