Mugumye ivyo nabategetse kandi mubikurikize. Ni jewe Uhoraho ndabeza.
Nihagira uwo muri mwebwe avuma se canke nyina, aze yicwe. Kuko yavumye se canke nyina, amaraso yiwe azoje ku mutwe wiwe.
Umugabo azosambana n’umugore w’uwundi mugabo, ni ukuvuga umugore wa mugenziwe, uwo mugabo n’uwo mugore bompi baze bicwe.
Umugabo niyasambana na muka se, azoba atetereje se. Uwo mugabo n’uwo mugore bompi baze bicwe; amaraso yabo azoje ku mitwe yabo.
Umugabo niyasambana n’umukazana wiwe, bompi baze bicwe. Kuko bazoba bakoze ikizira; amaraso yabo azoje ku mitwe yabo ubwabo.
Umugabo niyasambana n’uwundi mugabo nk’uko umugabo asambana n’umugore, bompi bazoba bakoze ivyo kwankwa urunuka. Baze bicwe; amaraso yabo azoje ku mitwe yabo ubwabo.
Umugabo niyarongora umugore na nyina w’uwo mugore, ico ni ubuyobe, yaba uwo mugabo, baba abo bagore, bose baze baturirwe, kugira ngo mukure ubuyobe muri mwebwe.
Umugabo niyasambana n’igikoko, aze yicwe, kandi n’ico gikoko muze mucice.
Umugore niyasambana n’igikoko, muze mwice uwo mugore n’ico gikoko. Vyompi bize vyicwe kandi amaraso yavyo azoje ku mutwe wiwe n’uw’ico gikoko.
Umugabo niyarongora mushikiwe, yaba uwo bavukana kuri se canke kuri nyina, bakaryamana, ni agatetereza. Baze bakurwe imbere yanyu. Kuko azoba yatetereje mushikiwe, azobizire.

Umugabo niyaryamana n’umugore ari mu miziro y’ukwezi, aze azire ko yerekanye isoko y’amaraso y’uwo mugore, uwo mugore na we ko yemeye kwiyambura no kuyerekana. Bompi baze bakurwe mu bwoko bwabo, kuko bemeranije kwerekana isoko y’amaraso y’uwo mugore.
Ntihaze hagire uwuryamana na nyinabo canke na inasenge, kuko kwoba ari ugutetereza incuti ya hafi; kandi bompi ntibaze babure kubizira.
Umugabo niyaryamana na muka sewabo canke na muka inarume, azoba atetereje sewabo canke inarume. Bompi bazobizira; bazopfa batavyaye.
Umugabo niyarongora muramuwe, kizoba ari igikorwa gitera guhumana. Nta mwana bazoronka, kuko azoba atetereje uwo bavukana.
Muze muzigame ivyo nabategetse vyose, n’amabwirizwa yanje yose, kandi muze mubikurikize, kugira ngo igihugu ngiye kubaha ntikize kibadahwe.
Ntimuze mukore ivyo amahanga ngiye gusohora imbere yanyu akora, kuko yakoze ivyo vyose nababujije, nanje nca ndayazinukwa.
Ariko mwebwe nababwiye nti: “Muzoragwa igihugu cabo; nzokibaha nk’iragi, ico gihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki.” Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu, yabatoranije mu yandi mahanga.

Mukwiye rero gutandukanya ibikoko bihumanye n’ibidahumanye, n’ibiguruka bihumanye n’ibidahumanye. Ntimuze mwihumanishe igikoko na kimwe canke ikiguruka na kimwe canke igikwega inda hasi, ivyo nababwiye ko bihumanye kuri mwebwe.
Mumbere abera kuko jewe, Uhoraho , ndi uwera, kandi nabatoranije mu yandi mahanga ngo mumbere ihanga niharije.
Umugabo canke umugore ahamagara imizimu canke abapfumu ari muri mwebwe aze yicwe. Muze mumwicishe amabuye; amaraso yiwe azoje ku mutwe wiwe ubwiwe.’ ”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati: “Vugana n’abaherezi, abahungu ba Aroni, ubabwire uti: ‘Ntihaze hagire umuherezi yihumanisha umuvyimba w’umuntu n’umwe w’incuti yiwe yapfuye,
kiretse incuti ya hafi, nka nyina canke se, umuhungu wiwe canke umukobwa wiwe, uwo bavukana w’umuhungu,
canke mushikiwe akiba iwe kuko atararongorwa; kuko abikoze ashobora kwihumanya.
Ntaze yihumanishe ab’iwabo n’umugore, ngo bitume ahumana.
Abaherezi ntibaze bimoshe umushatsi wose canke ubwanwa bwose canke ngo bikebagure ku mibiri yabo.
Baze babere Imana yabo abera kandi ntibaze batukishe izina ry’Imana yabo. Kuko ari bo bashikana ibimazi bituririwe Uhoraho , ari zo mfungurwa z’Imana yabo; ni co gituma bakwiye kuba abera.
Ntibaze barongore abagore bahumanijwe n’ubumaraya canke bahukanye n’abagabo babo, kuko abaherezi ari abejerejwe Uhoraho Imana yabo.
Muze mubafate nk’abera, kuko bashikanira Imana yanyu imfungurwa. Muze mubafate nk’abera, kuko jewe, Uhoraho , ndi uwera kandi ni jewe ndabeza.
Umukobwa w’umuherezi niyiyandurisha kuba maraya, azoba atetereje se; aze aturirwe mu muriro.

Umuherezi mukuru, umwe muri bamwe bavukana yasutswe ku mutwe ya mavuta yo kumurobanura, agatoranirizwa kuzokwambara za mpuzu z’ubuherezi, ntaze yigere asambura umushatsi canke ngo yitabagurireko impuzu.
Ntaze yigere yinjira ahari umuvyimba w’umuntu. Ntaze yigere yiyandurisha umuvyimba naho yoba ari se canke nyina,
canke ngo ave ahera h’Imana yiwe, canke ngo ahahumanye, kuko yatoranijwe asizwe amavuta yo kurobanura y’Imana yiwe. Ndi Uhoraho .
Umuherezi mukuru aze arongore umukobwa akiri isugi.
Ntaze arongore umupfakazi, uwahukanye, canke uwihumanishije kuba maraya, ahubwo aze arongore umukobwa akiri isugi wo mu bwoko bwiwe,
kugira ngo ntahumanye uruvyaro rwiwe mu bwoko bwiwe. Ndi Uhoraho , ni jewe ndamweza.’ ”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Bwira Aroni uti: ‘Uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi, ntihaze hagire uwo mu ruvyaro rwawe afise agasembwa azokwegera ngo ahereze imfungurwa z’Imana yiwe.
Ntihaze hagire uwufise agasembwa yegera ngo abikore, ari impumyi canke ikimuga, afise agasembwa mu maso, canke afise ubumuga bundi;
amugaye ikirenge canke ikiganza,
uwufise inyonzo canke ari impfunya, uwupfuye ijisho, uwugwaye uruhere, canke ibisebe biva amazi, canke uwamenetse amatengatwa.
Ntihaze hagire uwukomoka kuri Aroni umuherezi afise agasembwa azokwegera kugira ngo ashikane ishikanwa rituririrwa Uhoraho . Uwufise agasembwa ntaze yegere guhereza imfungurwa z’Imana yiwe.
Ashobora kurya kuri za mfungurwa zera z’Imana yiwe, no ku zera zose;
ariko kubera ubumuga bwiwe, ntaze yegere ca gihuzu gikingira ahera cane canke ngo yegere igicaniro, kuko yohava ahumanya ahera hanje. Ndi Uhoraho kandi ni jewe ndabeza.’ ”
Nuko Mose abibwira Aroni n’abahungu biwe n’Abisirayeli bose.
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Barira Aroni n’abahungu biwe bitondere cane amashikanwa Abisirayeli bateguye kunshikanira, kugira ngo ntibahumanye izina ryanje. Ndi Uhoraho .

Ubabwire uti: ‘Uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi, nihagira umwe wo mu ruvyaro rwanyu azoba ahumanye ariko akegera amashikanwa yera Abisirayeli bangeneye jewe Uhoraho , uwo muntu aze akurwe imbere yanje. Ndi Uhoraho .

Uwo mu ruvyaro rwa Aroni azogwara imibembe canke akagira ibimuva mu bihimba vy’irondoka, ntaze arye ku bimazi vyera gushika igihe azohumanurirwa. Azoba kandi ahumanye niyakora ku kintu candujwe n’umuvyimba canke n’umuntu yasheshe imbuto ziwe,
canke niyakora ku gakoko gatoya kose gashobora kumuhumanya, canke ku muntu wese yomuhumanya, ubuhumane ubwo ari bwo bwose.
Uwuzokora ku kintu nk’ico azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba. Ntaze yegere ibimazi vyera kiretse amaze kwiyuhagira n’amazi.
Izuba niryarenga, azoba ahumanuwe, hanyuma yaho azoba yemerewe kurya ku bimazi vyera, kuko ari imfungurwa ziwe.
Ntaze arye igikoko capfuye ata wucishe canke icatabaguwe n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba, kuko yohava avyiyandurisha. Ndi Uhoraho .
Abaherezi baze bitondere ivyo nihanikirije vyose kugira ngo ntibaze batsindwe n’urubanza bagahava bapfa bazize ko babikengereye. Ndi Uhoraho kandi ni jewe ndabeza.
Ntihaze hagire umuntu atari uwo mu muryango w’abaherezi, umushitsi agendeye umuherezi canke umukozi wiwe, arya ku bimazi vyera.
Ariko uwo muherezi niyagura umugurano n’amahera yiwe, canke niyaba ari umugurano yavukiye mu nzu yiwe, uwo mugurano ashobora kurya ku ndya ziwe.
Umukobwa w’umuherezi niyarongorwa n’uwundi muntu atari umuherezi, ntazoba yemerewe kurya ku vyera vyashikaniwe Imana.

Ariko umukobwa w’umuherezi niyaba umupfakazi canke akahukana, kandi ata bana araronka, hanyuma agasubira mu nzu kwa se nk’uko yari ari atararongorwa, azoba yemerewe kurya kuri izo ndya za se. Nta muntu n’umwe atabifitiye uburenganzira akwiye kurya kuri izo ndya.
Nihagira uwurya ku bimazi vyera atabizi, aze arihe uwo muherezi ico kimazi yariye yongereko ica gatanu c’ikiguzi caco.
Abaherezi ntibaze bakengereze ibimazi vyera Abisirayeli bashikaniye Uhoraho
mu kubemerera kubiryako bikabazanira gutsindwa, maze bigatuma batanga indishi. Ndi Uhoraho kandi ni jewe ndabeza.’ ”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:

“Vugana na Aroni n’abahungu biwe n’Abisirayeli bose uti: ‘Nihagira n’umwe wo muri mwebwe, yaba Umwisirayeli canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe, azotanga impano y’ikimazi co guturirira Uhoraho , caba ari ico gushitsa isezerano canke ico atanze avyishakiye,
aze atange ishuri itagira agasembwa akuye mu busho bwiwe, intama canke impene, kugira ngo ikimazi ciwe cemerwe.
Ntimuze muzane igikoko na kimwe gifise agasembwa, kuko kitazokwemerwa nk’ikimazi mutanze.

Nihagira uwuzana ikivuye mu masho canke mu mikuku kw’ikimazi c’ishimwe k’ Uhoraho co gushitsa isezerano canke co gushikana kuko avyishakiye, kize kibe ikitagira agasembwa canke umugayo kugira ngo cemerwe.

Ntimuze mushikanire Uhoraho icahumye, icamugaye canke icacitse amaboko canke amaguru, icagwaye urukoma canke uruhere canke ibisebe. Ntimuze muzane ku gicaniro ikimazi kimeze gityo ngo kibe ikimazi gishikaniwe Uhoraho giturizwa umuriro.

Mushobora kuzana ikimazi mutanze muvyishakiye; ishuri, intama canke impene ifise ukuguru canke ukuboko kugufi cane canke kurekure cane canke ngufi cane, ariko ntikizokwemerwa nk’ikimazi co gushitsa isezerano.
Ntimuze mushikanire Uhoraho igikoko gifise amatengatwa yamenetse, yajanjaguritse canke yacitse. Ntimuze mubikorere mu gihugu canyu,
kandi ntimuze mwemere ibikoko nk’ivyo mubihawe n’umunyamahanga ngo mubitange nk’imfungurwa z’Imana yanyu. Ntibizokwemerwa, kuko bimugaye kandi bifise agasembwa.’ ”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Nihavuka inyana, umwagazi w’intama canke w’impene, ize igumane na nyina imisi indwi. Kuva ku musi ugira umunani kubandanya, izoba yemewe gutangwa kw’ikimazi co guturirira Uhoraho .
Ntimuze mukerere inka canke intama n’inyana canke n’umwagazi wayo ku musi umwe.
Nimwatanga ikimazi co gukenguruka k’ Uhoraho , muze mugitange ku buryo cemerwa.
Kize kiribwe kuri uwo musi nyene; ntimuze musigaze na kimwe gushika mu gitondo. Ndi Uhoraho .
Muze mwitwararike ivyo ndabategeka kandi mubigendere. Ni jewe Uhoraho .
Ntimuze mukengereze izina ryanje. Ukwera kwanje gukwiye kumenyekana mu Bisirayeli. Ni jewe Uhoraho nabejeje
ndabakuye mu gihugu ca Egiputa kugira ngo ndababere Imana. Ndi Uhoraho .”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Iyi ni yo misi mikuru nashinze, jewe Uhoraho , iyo mukwiye gutangaza no kumenyesha ko ari iyera.

Mufise imisi itandatu yo gukora, ariko umusi ugira indwi ni Isabato yo kuruhuka, umusi w’ihuriro ryera. Ntimuze mugire igikorwa na kimwe mukora kuri uwo musi; aho muba hose, izoba ari Isabato y’ Uhoraho .
Iyi ni yo misi mikuru Uhoraho yashinze, amakoraniro yera mukwiye kumenyesha mu bihe vyayo:
Pasika y’ Uhoraho itangura ku mugoroba izuba rirenze ku musi ugira icumi na kane w’ukwezi kwa mbere.
Ku musi ugira icumi na gatanu w’ukwo kwezi, hazoba umusi mukuru w’imikate itambiye w’ Uhoraho ; muze mumare imisi indwi murya imikate itarimwo umwambiro.
Ku musi wa mbere muze mugire ikoraniro ryera kandi ntimuze mugire igikorwa muwukorako.
Muze mumare imisi indwi mushikanira Uhoraho ikimazi co guturirwa. Hanyuma ku musi ugira indwi muze mugire ikoraniro ryera kandi ntimuze mugire igikorwa muwukorako.’ ”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Nimwinjira mu gihugu ngiye kubaha, hanyuma mukimbura ivyeze muri co, muze muzanire umuherezi umukama w’ivyeze imbere y’ibindi mu vyo mwimbuye.
Na we aze azungagize uwo mukama imbere y’ Uhoraho , na wo uzokwemerwa ku bwanyu; uwo muherezi aze awuzungagize ku musi ukurikira Isabato.
Ku musi wo kuzungagiza uwo mukama, muze mutange umwagazi w’intama umaze umwaka kandi utagira agasembwa kw’ikimazi co guturirwa,

hamwe n’ishikanwa ry’ifu ingana na bibiri vy’icumi vy’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ivanze n’amavuta; ishikanwa ryo guturirwa rishikaniwe Uhoraho , ubumote bwiza; hamwe n’ishikanwa ry’ica kane c’ingero hini y’umuvinyu.

Ntimuze murye umukate n’umwe, intete zikaranze canke intete nshasha, kugeza kuri uwo musi muzotanga ico kimazi ku Mana yanyu. Iri rize ribe ibwirizwa rihoraho uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi, aho muzoba muba hose.
Kuva ku musi ukurikira isabato, ari wo musi mwazanyeko wa mukama w’ishikanwa ryo kuzunguza, muze muharure amayinga indwi yuzuye.
Muze muharure imisi mirongo itanu kugeza ku musi ukurikira Isabato igira indwi, hanyuma muce mutanga ishikanwa ry’ifu nshasha k’ Uhoraho .

Kuva aho muba hose, muze muzane imikate ibiri, umwe wose ukozwe muri bibiri vya cumi vy’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza, kandi ikaranze irimwo n’umwambiro, nk’ishikanwa ryo kuzungagiza ry’ivyeze imbere y’ibindi rishikaniwe Uhoraho .

Muze mutange uwo mukate hamwe n’impfizi z’intama indwi zikiri imyagazi, umwagazi wose uzobe umaze umwaka kandi utagira agasembwa, n’ishuri ikiri nto n’impfizi zibiri z’intama; ivyo bibe ibimazi vyo guturirirwa Uhoraho , ishikanwa ritanzwe hamwe n’amashikanwa y’ifu n’amashikanwa y’ibinyobwa bijanye, ari ryo shikanwa riturirwa rikaba ubumote bwiza buhimbara Uhoraho .
Hanyuma muze mushikane isuguru y’impene, ibe ikimazi c’ivyaha, hamwe n’imyagazi y’intama ibiri, imaze umwaka, ibe ikimazi c’ishimwe.

Umuherezi aze azungagize iyo myagazi ibiri imbere y’ Uhoraho nk’ishikanwa ryo kuzungagiza, hamwe na wa mukate ukozwe mu vyimburwa vyeze imbere y’ibindi. Bizoba ari ishikanwa ryera k’ Uhoraho kandi rizoba ari iry’umuherezi.
Kuri uwo musi nyene, muze mutangaze ikoraniro ryera kandi ntihaze hagire igikorwa na kimwe mukora. Iryo rize ribe itegeko rihoraho uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi, aho muzoba muba hose.

Nimwimbura ivyo mu gihugu canyu, ntimuze mwimbure ivyameze hirya y’urubibe rwanyu canke ngo musubire inyuma gutoragura ivyasigaye mu mirima. Muze mubirekere abakene n’inyambukira. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.’ ”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Barira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Umusi wa mbere w’ukwezi kw’indwi muze muwuruhukeko, ribe ikoraniro ryera muhimbarisha kuvuza inzamba.
Ntimuze mugire igikorwa muwukorako ariko muze mushikanire Uhoraho ikimazi co guturirwa.’ ”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Umusi ugira icumi w’uko kwezi kw’indwi uzobe umusi wo gutanga ikimazi co kwicungura. Muze mugire ikoraniro ryera mwisonzeshe, kandi mushikanire Uhoraho ikimazi co guturirwa.
Ntimuze mukore kuri uwo musi, kuko uzoba ari umusi wo gutanga ikimazi co kwicungura, umusi mutangirako ikimazi gituma mwemerwa n’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Umuntu wese atazokwisonzesha kuri uwo musi aze arandurwe mu bwoko bwiwe.
Nzorandura mu muryango wiwe umuntu wese azogira ico akoze kuri uwo musi.
Ntihaze hagire ikintu na kimwe mukora. Iri rize ribe itegeko rihoraho uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi, aho muzoba muba hose.
Izoba ari Isabato yo kuruhuka kuri mwebwe, kandi muze mwisonzeshe. Kuva ku mugoroba w’umusi ugira icenda w’uko kwezi gushika ku mugoroba ukurikira muze mwitondere Isabato yanyu.”
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Barira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Ku musi ugira icumi na gatanu w’ukwezi kw’indwi ni ho umusi mukuru w’ Uhoraho w’insago uzoba utanguye, kandi uzomara imisi indwi.
Umusi wa mbere uze ube uw’ikoraniro ryera; ntimuze muwukoreko igikorwa na kimwe.

Muze mumare imisi indwi mushikanira Uhoraho ibimazi vyo guturirwa, hanyuma ku musi ugira umunani muze mugire ikoraniro ryera, mushikane ibimazi bituririrwa Uhoraho . Rizoba ari ikoraniro ryo gusozera; ntimuze mugire igikorwa na kimwe muwukorako.

(Iyo ni yo misi mikuru itegetswe n’ Uhoraho . Muze muyihimbaze mukoranya amakoraniro yejejwe yo gutanga kw’ibimazi vyo guturirira Uhoraho , ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’amashikanwa y’ifu, ibimazi n’amashikanwa vy’ibinyobwa vyategetswe ku musi ku musi.

Ivyo bimazi ni ibizoba vyiyongera kuri bimwe bitangwa ku masabato y’ Uhoraho no kuri vya bimazi mutanga nk’ingabire, no kuri bimwe vyo gushitsa isezerano n’ivyo mutanga muvyishakiye mukabishikanira Uhoraho .)

Nuko rero kuva ku musi ugira icumi na gatanu w’ukwezi kw’indwi, mumaze kwimbura ivyimburwa vyo mu gihugu, muze muhimbaze umusi mukuru w’ Uhoraho uzomara imisi indwi; umusi wa mbere uzoba ari uwo kuruhuka, n’umusi w’umunani na wo nyene ni uwo kuruhuka.

Ku musi wa mbere muze muzane ibirusha ibindi kuba vyiza mu vyamye ku biti, amashami y’ibigazi, amashami y’ibiti vy’amababi maninimanini n’ibiti bimera i ruhande y’amazi atemba, hanyuma munezererwe imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu kumara imisi indwi.
Muze muwuhimbaze nk’umusi mukuru w’ Uhoraho uzomara imisi indwi uko umwaka utashe. Iri rize ribe itegeko rihoraho uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi; muze muwuhimbaze mu kwezi kw’indwi.
Muze mube mu nsago kumara imisi indwi: Abisirayeli bose b’imvukira baze babe mu nsago
kugira ngo abana banyu baze bamenye ko jewe natumye Abisirayeli baba mu nsago igihe nabakura mu gihugu ca Egiputa. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.’ ”
Nuko Mose amenyesha Abisirayeli imisi mikuru yose yashinzwe n’ Uhoraho .
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Ubarire Abisirayeli bazane amavuta ya elayo ateguwe neza yo gucana amatara, kugira ngo azogume yaka ibihe vyose.

Mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, hino y’igitambara gikingira Isandugu y’Isezerano, ni ho Aroni azoyatereka kugira ngo yame yaka adahengeshanya imbere y’ Uhoraho , kuva ku mugoroba gushika mu gitondo. Iryo rize ribe ibwirizwa rihoraho uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi.
Ayo matara aze yame ashirwa ku giterekwako amatara c’inzahabu itavanze imbere y’ Uhoraho ubudasiba.
Muze mufate ifu mucumbe imikate icumi n’ibiri, mukoresheje bibiri vya cumi vy’ingero efa ku mukate umwe umwe.
Muze muyitondeke ku mirongo ibiri, ku murongo wose hajeko itandatu itandatu, ku meza ikozwe mu nzahabu itavanze imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Muze mushire ibimota neza i ruhande y’umurongo wose, bibe ku mikate nk’icibutso, nk’ishikanwa riturirwa imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Iyo mikate ize yame ishirwa imbere y’ Uhoraho ubudasiba, uko Isabato ikurikirana n’iyindi, kubw’Abisirayeli, nk’isezerano ridahera.
Izoba ari iya Aroni n’abahungu biwe, na bo baze bayirire ahera, kuko ari umugabane wera cane bagerewe kuzohora baronka ku mashikanwa atuririwe Uhoraho .”
Umusi umwe habaye amatati aho bari bacumbitse, hagati y’Umwisirayeli n’umuhungu yari afise se w’Umunyegiputa na nyina w’Umwisirayelikazi.
Maze uwo muhungu w’Umunyegiputa n’Umwisirayelikazi atuka rya Zina ararivuma; maze baca bamuzanira Mose. (Nyina wiwe yitwa Shelomite, umukobwa wa Diburi wo mu muryango wa Dani.)
Baca bamushira mw’ibohero gushika bamenyeshejwe neza ubugombe bw’ Uhoraho .
Nuko Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Sohora uwo yatutse izina ryanje inyuma y’aho mucumbitse. Maze abamwumvise bose babe ari bo barambika ibiganza ku mutwe wiwe, maze ikoraniro ryose rimwicishe amabuye.
Bwira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Nihagira uwuvuma Izina ry’Imana yiwe, azobizira;
umuntu wese azotuka izina ry’ Uhoraho aze yicwe. Ikoraniro ryose rize rimwicishe amabuye. Yaba imvukira canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe; niyatuka iryo zina, aze yicwe.
Nihagira uwica umuntu, na we aze yicwe.
Nihagira uwica igitungano c’uwundi aze akirihe, ubugingo bwishurwe ubundi.
Umuntu niyakomeretsa mugenziwe, ico azoba yakoze na we aze agikorerwe.
Imvune ihorwe iyindi, ijisho rihorwe irindi, iryinyo rihorwe irindi. Uko azoba yakomerekeje mugenziwe, na we aze abe ari ko akomeretswa.
Uwishe igikoko aze akirihe, ariko uwishe umuntu aze yicwe.
Muze mugire itegeko rimwe ku munyamahanga n’imvukira. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.’ ”
Nuko Mose avugana n’Abisirayeli, na bo bafata wa muntu yatutse izina ry’ Uhoraho bamujana inyuma y’aho bacumbitse. Abisirayeli bakora nk’uko Uhoraho yari yategetse Mose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ari ku musozi Sinayi ati:
“Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Nimwinjira igihugu ngiye kubaha, ico gihugu ubwaco kize cubahirize Isabato y’ Uhoraho .
Muze murime imirima yanyu imyaka itandatu, kandi muri iyo myaka itandatu muze mututurire imizabibu yanyu mwongere mwegeranye ivyimburwa vyayo.
Ariko mu mwaka ugira indwi isi ize ironke akaruhuko k’Isabato, Isabato y’ Uhoraho . Ntimuze mubibe canke ngo mutere ikintu na kimwe mu mirima yanyu canke ngo mututurire imizabibu yanyu.
Ntimuze mwimbure ivyimejeje muri yo kandi ntimuze mwamure imizabibu yamye ku biti bidatuturiye. Isi ize ironke umwaka w’akaruhuko.
Ivyo imirima izokwama vyose bize bibe ivyokurya vyanyu, mwebwe ubwanyu, abagurano banyu n’abaguranokazi banyu, n’abakozi banyu canke abashitsi bari i wanyu,
n’ibitungano vyanyu n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba vyo mu gihugu canyu. Ivyo igihugu kimejeje vyose bishobora kuribwa.
Muze muharure amasabato indwi y’imyaka, ni ukuvuga imyaka indwi incuro indwi, kugira ngo ayo masabato indwi y’imyaka akwize imyaka mirongo ine n’icenda.
Hanyuma muzoce muvuza inzamba hose ku musi ugira icumi w’ukwezi kw’indwi; ku musi wo gutanga ikimazi co kwicungura muze muvuze inzamba mu gihugu cose.
Muze mweze umwaka ugira mirongo itanu muri mu gihugu mwamamaze umwidegemvyo ku bakibamwo bose.
Uwo mwaka ugira mirongo itanu uze ube Yubile kuri mwebwe; ntimuze mugire ico mubiba canke mutera ngo mugire ico mwimbura ku vyimejeje canke ngo mwamure inzabibu ku mizabibu mutatuturiye.
Kuko izoba ari Yubile kandi izoba ari iyejejwe kuri mwebwe; muze murye ivyo mwamuye mu mirima.
Muri uwo mwaka wa Yubile umuntu wese aze asubire mw’itongo ryiwe.
Nimwagurisha itongo ku wo mu bwoko bwanyu canke mukarimugurira, ntihaze hagire uwuzimba uwundi.
Muze mugure amatongo y’abo mu bwoko bwanyu mukurikije imyaka mumaze Yubile ibaye. Kandi muze mugurishe amatongo kuri bagenzi banyu mukurikije imyaka isigaye yo kwimbura mu mirima yanyu.
Imyaka niyaba ari myinshi, muze muduze igiciro, na ho niyaba ari mike, muze mumanure igiciro, kuko ico muzoba muriko muragurisha ari igitigiri c’ibihe vyo kwimbura.
Ntihaze hagire uwurenganya uwundi, ariko muze mutinye Imana yanyu. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Muze mukurikize amategeko yanje kandi mwitwaririke kwumvira ivyagezwe vyanje, ni ho muzoba amahoro muri ico gihugu.
Aho ni ho igihugu kizokwera ivyamwa vyaco, namwe muzorya muhage kandi muzokibamwo mu mutekano.
Mwoshobora kubaza muti: “Tuzorya iki mu mwaka ugira indwi nitutatera ngo twimbure ivyimburwa vyacu?”
Nzobarungikira umugisha mu mwaka ugira gatandatu ku buryo imirima izotanga ivyimburwa vyo kubatunga imyaka itatu.
Mu gihe co kubiba mu mwaka ugira umunani, muzoba mukirya ibihitira kandi muzokomeza kubirya gushika aho muzokwimburira ivyo mu mwaka ugira icenda.
Ntihaze hagire uwugurisha itongo rimwe burundu, kuko amatongo ari ayanje namwe mukaba ba kavantara n’abakozi banje.
Mu gihugu cose muhawe ngo mucegukire, muze mutegurire amatongo igihe co gucungurwa.
Umwisirayeli wo mu bwoko bwanyu niyakena akagurisha igice c’itongo ryiwe, uwo mu ncuti ziwe za hafi aze acungure rya tongo yagurishije.
Ariko uwo muntu niyaba atagira uwo kumucungurira iryo tongo, ariko hanyuma agatunga akaronka ivyo kuricungura,
aze aharure ikiguzi gikwiranye n’igihe rimaze uhereye igihe yarigurisha ace asubiza ayasigaye uwari yariguze; aho rero azoce asubirana itongo ryiwe.
Ariko nataronka ivyo kurigaruza, aho yagurishije haze hagume ari aha nyene kuhagura kugeza ku mwaka wa Yubile. Haze hasubizwe kuri Yubile, hasubire kuba aha nyeneho.
Umuntu niyagurisha inzu iri mu gisagara kizitijwe inzitiro, azoba ashobora kuyicungura mu kiringo c’umwaka kuva igurishijwe. Muri ico kiringo gusa ni ho azoba ashobora kuyicungura.
Niyaba atashoboye kuyicungura ico kiringo kikamurengana, iyo nzu iri mu gisagara kizitijwe uruzitiro ize yegukire nyene kuyigura n’uruvyaro rwiwe. Ntize isubizwe mu gihe ca Yubile.
Ariko inzu ziri mu mihana ahantu hatagira inzitiro zize zifatwe nk’amatongo. Zirashobora gucungurwa, kandi zize zisubizwe kuri Yubile.
Abalewi bazokwama bafise uburenganzira bwo gucungura inzu zabo ziri mu bisagara vyagerewe Abalewi.

Nuko rero amatongo y’Abalewi ashobora gucungurwa; yaba inzu yagurishijwe iri mu gisagara ico ari co cose bagabiwe, kandi ize isubizwe mu gihe ca Yubile, kuko inzu muri ivyo bisagara vy’Abalewi ari umugabane wabo mu Bisirayeli.
Ariko ahantu h’uburagiro bwegukira ibisagara vyabo ntivyemewe kuhagurisha; ni umugabane wabo imyaka yose.

Umuntu wo mu bwoko bwanyu niyakena ntashobore kuronka ikimutunga kimubeshaho, muze mumufashe nk’uko mwobikorera umunyamahanga canke inyambukira iri muri mwebwe, kugira ngo ashobore kubaho muri mwebwe.
Ntimuze murondere kumuronkako inyungu iyo ari yo yose, ariko muze mwubahe Imana yanyu, kugira ngo uwo muntu wo mu bwoko bwanyu ashishikare kuba muri mwebwe.
Ntimuze mumugurane amahera mwiteze ko abungukira canke ngo mumugurisheko ivyo gufungura mugomba kumwungukako.
Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu, nabakuye mu gihugu ca Egiputa kugira ngo ndabahe igihugu c’i Kanani nongere ndababere Imana.
Nihagira uwo mu bwoko bwanyu aba umukene ari muri mwebwe hanyuma akigurisha kuri mwebwe, ntimuze mumukoreshe nk’umugurano.
Aze akoreshwe nk’umukozi aca ingero canke nk’umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe, aze abakorere gushika ku mwaka wa Yubile.
Hanyuma we n’abana biwe baze bidegemvye, na we aze asubire mu muryango wiwe no mw’itongo rya ba sekuruza.
Kuko Abisirayeli ari abakozi banje, abo naguze nkabakura muri Egiputa, ntibaze bagurishwe nk’abagurano.
Ntimuze mubatwaze igitugu, ariko mwubahe Imana yanyu.
Abagurano n’abaguranokazi banyu baze bave mu mahanga abakikuje; muri abo ni ho muzoshobora kugura abagurano.
Mushobora kandi kubagura mu bantu b’inyambukira baba muri mwebwe no mu bo mu miryango yabo bavukiye iwanyu, na bo bazoba inyegu zanyu.
Mushobora no kubaraga abahungu banyu kandi mushobora kubatunga nk’abagurano ubuzima bwabo bwose, ariko ntimuze mutwaze amanyama Umwisirayeli mugenzi wanyu.
Uwo mu banyamahanga aba muri mwebwe niyatunga maze uwo mu bwoko bwanyu agakena akigurisha kuri uwo munyamahanga aba muri mwebwe canke ku bo mu muryango wiwe,
aze agumane uburenganzira bwo gucungurwa amaze kwigurisha, uwo mu ncuti ziwe ashobora kumucungura.
Sewabo canke inarume canke muvyarawe canke incuti iyo ari yo yose yo mu muryango wiwe ishobora kumucungura; canke niyatunga, ashobora kwicungura.
We n’uwo yamuguze baze baharure uhereye umwaka yamuguzemwo kugeza ku mwaka wa Yubile. Igiciro co kumucungura kize giharurwe bakoresheje impembo y’umukozi muri iyo myaka yose.
Nihaba hasigaye imyaka myinshi, aze arihe igice kinini c’amahera yaguzwe.
Nihaba hasigaye imyaka mike ngo Yubile ishike, aze aharure amahera asigaye abe ari yo ariha.
Aze afatwe nk’umukozi yahawe akazi ku mwaka ku mwaka; muze mubikurikirane neza kugira ngo uwo yamuguze ntamutwaze amanyama.
Naho atoshobora gucungurwa muri ubwo buryo, we n’abana biwe baze bidegemvye mu mwaka wa Yubile,
Kuko Abisirayeli ari abakozi banje, abo naguze nkabakura muri Egiputa. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze mukore ibigirwamana canke ngo mwishingire ibishushanyo canke inkingi z’amabuye, kandi ntimuze mushinge ivyabajwe mu mabuye mu gihugu ngo muvyunamire. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Muze mwitondere amasabato yanje kandi mwubahe ahera hanje. Ndi Uhoraho .
Nimwitondera ivyo nashinze, mugashira umutima ku kwitondera amabwirizwa yanje,
nzobarungikira imvura mu gihe cayo, kandi isi izokwera ivyimburwa vyayo n’ibiti vyame ivyamwa vyavyo.
Iyimbura ryanyu ry’ingano rizogeza kw’iyimbura ry’inzabibu, n’iyimbura ry’inzabibu rishike mw’ibiba, kandi muzorya ivyo mugomba mube amahoro mu gihugu canyu.
Nzobaha amahoro mu gihugu, kandi muzokwiryamira ata kintu kibaca ivutu. Nzokura ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba mu gihugu, kandi nta nkota izoca mu gihugu canyu.
Muzokinagiza abansi banyu, kandi bazokwicwa n’inkota imbere yanyu.
Batanu bo muri mwebwe bazokinagiza ijana, n’ijana bo muri mwebwe bakinagize ibihumbi icumi, kandi abansi banyu muzobamarisha inkota.
Nzobarabisha ijisho ry’urukundo kandi nzobaha kurondoka mugwire, ngumizeho isezerano nasezeranye namwe.
Muzoba mukirya ivyo mwimbuye umwaka uheze, hanyuma murondere ingene mubisohora kugira ngo muronke aho mwimburira ivyeze.
Nzoshinga ihema ryanje hagati muri mwebwe, kandi sinzobaheba.
Nzogendera hagati yanyu, mbe Imana yanyu namwe mube abantu banje.
Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu, nabakuye muri Egiputa kugira ngo muve mu buja bw’Abanyegiputa. Navunaguye ivyuma vy’ingogo vyanyu ndabaha kugenda mwemye.
Ariko nimutanyumvira ngo mwitondere aya mabwirizwa yose,
maze mugashiburira kure ivyo nashinze vyose mugakengera ivyagezwe vyanje mukananirwa no kwitondera amabwirizwa yanje yose, mukongera mukava mw’isezerano ryanje,
nanje uku ni ko nzobagirira: nzobateza ibibaca ivutu, ingwara zidakira n’akaranda bitume muba impumyi bibamare inkomezi. Muzobibira ubusa, kuko abansi banyu ari bo bazobirya.
Igitsure canje kizoguma kuri mwebwe bitume mutsindwa n’abansi banyu; ababanka ni bo bazobaganza, kandi muzohunga ata wubirukanye.
Ivyo nibitatuma munyumvira, nzobahanira ivyaha vyanyu incuro indwi.
Nzovunagura ubwibone bwanyu ntume ijuru ribabera nk’icuma isi na yo ibabere nk’umuringa.
Muzoruhira ubusa, kuko igihugu kitazokwera ivyimburwa vyaco, canke ngo ibiti vyo mu gihugu canyu vyame ivyamwa vyavyo.
Nimwashishikara kuba abansi banje mukanka kunyumvira, nzogwiza ivyago vyanyu incuro indwi ndabahora ivyaha vyanyu.
Nzobarungikira ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba bibatere, bibatware abana banyu, bihonye n’amasho yanyu bitume muba inkehwa maze amayira yanyu asigare agaragara.
Naho nyene nimwanka kwemera ngo muhanurwe mugashishikara kuba abansi banje,
nanje nzohinduka umwansi wanyu ndabateze ivyago birushirije incuro indwi kubera ivyaha vyanyu.
Nzoca ndabateza inkota ndabahoye ko mwavuye mw’isezerano ryanje. Nimwahungira mu bisagara vyanyu nzobateza ikiza kandi muzogwa mu maboko y’abansi banyu.
Ninazibira aho mukura ivyokurya, abagore icumi bazoshobora gukarangira mu nkono imwe, kandi bazobagaburira ibipimwe, kandi naho muzobirya ntimuzohaga.
Naho nzoba nabagiriye gutyo, nimwashishikara kuja kure yanje,
nanje nzobarakira ndabaje kure, kandi jewe ubwanje nzobahanira ivyaha vyanyu incuro indwi.
Muzorya inyama z’abahungu banyu n’abakobwa banyu.
Nzosambura ibibanza vyanyu vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi, n’ibicaniro vy’ibimota neza vyanyu nzobisenyurira hasi, ngerekeranye imivyimba yanyu ku bigirwamana vyanyu bitagira ubugingo, ndabanke urunuka.
Ibisagara vyanyu nzobihindura imisaka, nsambure ingoro musengeramwo, kandi n’ibimota neza vy’amashikanwa yanyu bizoba igisesema kuri jewe.
Jewe ubwanje nzosambura igihugu canyu, gushika aho abansi banyu bazokigereramwo bazotangara cane.
Nzobasanzariza mu mahanga nsokorore inkota yanje ndabakinagize. Igihugu canyu kizoba amatongo, kandi ibisagara vyanyu bizosigara ari imisaka.
Igihugu kizonezererwa imyaka y’amasabato yaco igihe cose kizoba ari amatongo namwe muri mu gihugu c’abansi banyu; igihugu na co kizoruhuka amasabato yaco.
Mu gihe cose kizoba ari amatongo, kizoruhuka akaruhuko k’amasabato kitaruhutse igihe mwari mukiri muri co.

Nzotuma abasigaye ari amasigarira baranduka imitima bari mu bihugu vy’abansi babo, ku buryo n’akababi kaguruwe n’umuyaga gatuma bahunga. Bazokwiruka nk’abahunga inkota, maze bagwe hasi, naho ata n’umwe azoba ariko arabakinagiza.
Umuntu azotsitara kuri mugenziwe nk’aho boba bariko barahunga inkota, naho ata n’umwe azoba ariko arabakinagiza. Uko ni ko mutazoshobora guhagarara imbere y’abansi banyu.
Muzohonera mu mahanga; igihugu c’abansi banyu kizobatsontsomera.
Abazosigara bazohonera mu gihugu c’abansi banyu ku bw’ivyaha vyabo n’ivya ba sekuruza babo.
Ariko nibatura ivyaha vyabo n’ivya ba sekuruza babo, ubuhemu bwabo n’urwanko banyanka jewe,
rwatumye nanje ndabazinukwa bigatuma ndabirukanira mu gihugu c’abansi babo, maze imitima yabo y’intakebwa igacishwa bugufi bakishura ivyaha bakoze,
nzokwibuka isezerano nasezeranye na Yakobo n’iryo nasezeranye na Isaka n’iryo nasezeranye na Aburahamu, bitume nibuka igihugu.
Kuko igihugu bazokivamwo na co kikanezererwa amasabato yaco igihe kizoba ari amatongo batakikibamwo. Bazokwishura ivyaha bakoze kuko bataye ivyagezwe vyanje bagatera ibitugu ivyo nihanikirije.
Ariko naho biri uko, igihe bazoba bari mu gihugu c’abansi babo, sinzobata canke ngo ndabahebe ngo bitume ndabaherengeteza rwose, ngo mve mw’isezerano nasezeranye na bo. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yabo.
Ariko ku bwabo nzokwibuka isezerano nasezeranye na ba sekuruza babo, abo nakuye mu gihugu ca Egiputa amahanga yose abibona, ngo mbe Imana yabo. Ndi Uhoraho .’ ”
Ivyo ni vyo vyashinzwe, vyagezwe n’amabwirizwa, ivyo Uhoraho yashingiye ku musozi Sinayi, hagati yiwe n’Abisirayeli abicishije kuri Mose.
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
“Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Umuntu niyasezerana isezerano ryo gushikanira Uhoraho umuntu, aze abikore abicishije mu gutanga amahera angana n’igiciro ciwe,
muze mushinge ko igiciro c’izina muhungu ari hagati y’imyaka mirongo ibiri na mirongo itandatu gihuye na shekeli mirongo itanu z’ifeza, hakoreshejwe ingero shekeli y’Ahera;
niyaba ari umuntu w’igitsina gore, muze mushinge shekeli mirongo itatu.
Niyaba umuntu ari hagati y’imyaka itanu na mirongo ibiri, muze mushinge igiciro c’umuhungu kuri shekeli mirongo ibiri na shekeli icumi ku mukobwa.
Niyaba ari umuntu ari hagati y’ukwezi kumwe n’imyaka itanu, ku muhungu muze mushinge shekeli zitanu na shekeli zitatu z’ifeza ku mukobwa.
Niyaba ari umuntu afise imyaka mirongo itandatu n’iyirenga, muze mushinge shekeli icumi na zitanu ku mugabo na shekeli icumi z’ifeza ku mugore.

Uwagize iyo ndahiro niyaba ari umukene cane ku buryo atoshobora kuriha ico kiguzi cashinzwe, aze azane uwo muntu ku muherezi, na we aze amushingire igiciro gihwanye n’ico nyene gusezerana ashobora kuronka.
Ico yasezeranye nicaba ari igikoko cemewe gutangwako ikimazi gishikanirwa Uhoraho , ico gikoko gihawe Uhoraho kizoba kibaye icera.

Ntaze akiguze n’ikindi, ari ciza ngo agisubirize na kibi canke ari kibi ngo agisubirize na ciza; bikenewe ko asubiriza ico gikoko, caba ico gusubirizwa canke ikigisubirira, vyompi bizoba bibaye ivyera.
Niyaba ico yasezeranye ari igihumanye, kidashobora gushikanirwa Uhoraho nk’ikimazi, ico gikoko kize kizanirwe umuherezi,
na we aze arabe uko kimeze ko ari ciza canke kibi. Igiciro uwo muherezi azoshinga ico ari co cose kizoba ari ico nyene.
Nyeneco niyashaka kugicungura, aze yongereko ikigira gatanu c’igiciro caco.
Umuntu niyatanga inzu yiwe ngo ibe iyerejwe Uhoraho , umuherezi aze avuge ko ari nziza canke ari mbi. Igiciro ico ari co cose umuherezi azoshinga kizoguma ari ico nyene.
Uwo muntu nyene kuyitanga niyagomba kuyicungura, aze yongereko ica gatanu ku giciro cayo, iyo nzu rero izoheza isubire kumwegukira.

Umuntu niyatanga igice c’itongo ry’umuryango wiwe ngo ribe iryerejwe Uhoraho , igiciro caryo kize gishingwe baravye imbuto ziterwa muri ryo uko zingana: shekeli mirongo itanu ku ngero homeru imwe ya sayiri.
Niyatanga iryo tongo mu mwaka wa Yubile, igiciro cashinzwe kizoguma ari ico nyene.
Ariko niyatanga iryo tongo inyuma ya Yubile, umuherezi aze ashinge igiciro yisunze imyaka isigaye kugira ngo Yubile yindi ishike, kugira ngo igiciro caryo kigabanurwe.
Uwo muntu yaritanze niyagomba kuricungura, aze yongereko ica gatanu c’igiciro caryo, hanyuma iryo tongo rize risubire kumwegukira.
Ariko natacungura iryo tongo, canke niyaba yarigurishije n’uwundi, ntirize ryigere ricungurwa.
Igihe iryo tongo rizosubirizwa kuri Yubile, rizoca riba iryera, nk’uko bigenda kw’itongo ryeguriwe Uhoraho ; rizoca riba iry’abaherezi.
Umuntu niyatanga itongo yaguze ngo ribe iryerejwe Uhoraho , itongo atari iry’umuryango,
umuherezi aze ashinge igiciro caryo aharuye imyaka isigaye ngo Yubile ishike, hanyuma uwo muntu aze arihe ico kiguzi kuri uwo musi nyene nk’ikintu cerejwe Uhoraho .
Mu mwaka wa Yubile iryo tongo rizoca risubizwa nyene kurigurisha, nyeneryo imbere y’uko rigurishwa.
Ikiguzi cose kize gishingwe hakoreshejwe ingero shekeli y’Ahera, ingero gera mirongo ibiri zibe shekeli imwe.
Ariko ntihaze hagire n’umwe azotanga igikoko c’uburiza, kuko ivy’uburiza vyose bisanzwe ari ivy’ Uhoraho ; yaba inka, canke intama, ni ivy’ Uhoraho .
Nicaba ari kimwe mu bikoko bihumanye, ashobora kugitangira ikiguzi cashinzwe, akongerako ica gatanu caco. Natagicungura, kize kigurishwe ku giciro cashinzwe.

Ariko ntihaze hagire ikintu na kimwe ceguriwe Uhoraho , yaba umuntu canke igikoko canke itongo ry’umuryango, kizogurishwa canke ngo gicungurwe; ikintu cose ceguriwe Uhoraho kizoba ari icera cane k’ Uhoraho .
Naho yoba ari umuntu yeguriwe Uhoraho ngo yicwe, ntaze acungurwe; aze yicwe.
Ikigiracumi c’ibintu vyose biva mu mirima, vyaba ivyo mu kuzimu canke ivyama ku biti, ni ic’ Uhoraho ; kandi ni icera k’ Uhoraho .
Umuntu niyacungura na kimwe mu bigiracumi, aze yongereko ica gatanu c’igiciro caco.
Ikigiracumi gikwiye co mu masho no mu mikuku, ni ukuvuga ikigiracumi mu vyo umwungere aharuye biciye musi y’inkoni yiwe, kizoba ari icera k’ Uhoraho .
Ntaze atoranyemwo nziza muri mbi canke ngo agire iyo asubiriza iyindi. Niyagira iyo asubiriza, iyasubirijwe n’iyayisubiriye zose zizoba ari izera kandi ntizize zicungurwe.’ ”
Ayo ni yo mategeko Uhoraho yahaye Mose ku musozi Sinayi ngo ayashikirize Abisirayeli.
